verses.text: Aya ni yo mazina y’abahungu ba Isirayeli bagiye muri Egiputa bajanye na Yakobo ari we Isirayeli, umwe wese ari kumwe n’umuryango wiwe:
Reyubeni, Simeyoni, Lewi, Yuda,
Isakari, Zebuloni, Benyamini;
Dani, Nafutali; Gadi, na Asheri.
Abakomoka kuri Yakobo bagiye muri Egiputa bari mirongo indwi; Yosefu we yari yaramaze gushika muri Egiputa.
Nuko igihe kiragera, Yosefu n’ab’urunganwe rwiwe barapfa.
Ababakomotseko ari bo Bisirayeli bavyara abana n’abuzukuru benshi cane; baragwira, baba abantu bahambaye birengeje, buzura igihugu cose.
Maze muri Egiputa, himikwa uwundi mwami atigeze amenya ivya Yosefu.
Abwira Abanyegiputa ati: “Murabona ko Abisirayeli babaye benshi kandi bakomeye kuturusha.
Dutegerezwa kugira ico dukoze kugira ngo tubabuze kugwira, ahandi ho nihagira intambara itera, bazokwifatanya n’abansi bacu maze batugwanye, hanyuma bave mu gihugu cacu bigire.”
Ni ko guca babagira abagurano babo, bagena ababakurikirana babakoresha ibikorwa bigoye vy’agacinyizo, mu kwubaka ibisagara vy’ubushinguro bwa Farawo vy’i Ramusesi n’i Pitoni.
Ariko uko babacinyiza ni ko barushiriza kugwira no gukwiragira hose, kandi Abanyegiputa bikarushiriza kubatera ubwoba.
Baca barushirizaho kubababarisha ibikorwa vy’ubuja.

Batuma ubuzima bwabo bubarusha bumera nk’umururazi, mu kubakoresha mu vyondo ibikorwa bibabaza vyo kubumba amatafari, hamwe n’ibindi bitandukanye vyo mu mirima; kandi mu vyo babakoresha vyose bakabababaza cane.
Umwami wa Egiputa abarira abakirizi b’Abaheburayokazi, ari bo Shifura na Puwa,
ati: “Nimwakira Umuheburayokazi, mugasanga avyaye umuhungu, muzoce mumuniga. Ariko nimwasanga ari umukobwa, muze mumureke abeho.”
Ariko abo bakirizi barubaha Imana, maze ntibumvira ivyo umwami yabategetse.
Nuko umwami wa Egiputa ahamagaza ba bakirizi arababaza ati: “Ivyo mwakoze ni ibiki? Ni kubera iki mwaretse abana b’abahungu bakabaho?”
Ba bakirizi baramwishura bati: “Abagore b’Abaheburayokazi ntibameze nk’Abanyegiputakazi; bafise inkomezi, umwakirizi agera kuhashika bamaze kuvyara.”
Maze Imana igirira neza abo bakirizi, Abisirayeli na bo barushiriza kugwira, baba ihanga rinini.
Kandi kuko abo bakirizi bubashe Imana, na yo ica ibaha uruvyaro mu miryango yabo bwite.
Nuko Farawo aca atanga itegeko ku bantu bose ati: “Umwana wese azovuka ari umuhungu muze mumuterere mu ruzi Nili, ariko umukobwa muze mumureke abeho.”
Ico gihe umugabo wo mu muryango wa Lewi arongora umugore wo muri uwo muryango nyene.
Uwo mugore asama inda, avyara umwana w’umuhungu. Abonye ingene uwo mwana ari mwiza, aca aramunyegeza kumara amezi atatu.

Ariko, abonye ko atagishoboye kuguma amunyegeje, aca yakira agaseke gakozwe mu nkorogoto, aragahoma neza akoresheje ikaburimbi n’uburembo, hanyuma aca amutereka mu rufunzo rwo ku nkengera y’uruzi Nili.
Mushiki w’uwo mwana aca ahagarara hirya yaho kugira ngo arabe ivyomushikira.
Hanyuma umukobwa wa Farawo amanuka ku ruzi kwiyuhagira, incoreke ziwe na zo ziba ziratembera ku nkengera y’uruzi. Nuko abona ka gaseke kari mu rufunzo aca atuma incoreke yiwe kukamuzanira.
Agapfunduruye asanga karimwo umwana. Uwo mwana yariko ararira hanyuma aca amugirira impuhwe, aravuga ati: “Uwu ategerezwa kuba ari umwe mu bana b’Abaheburayo.”
Maze mushiki w’uwo mwana aca abaza uwo mukobwa wa Farawo ati: “Nje mu Baheburayokazi kukuronderera umugore yomukwonkereza, akamurera?”
Na we aramwishura ati: “Egome, genda.” Mushikiwe aca aja guhamagara nyina wiwe.
Wa mukobwa wa Farawo aramubwira ati: “Akira uwu mwana umunyonkereze, nzoguhera.” Wa mugore aca aramwakira aja kumurera.
Umwana amaze gukura, aca amutwara kwa wa mukobwa wa Farawo, aba umuhungu wiwe. Aca amwita Mose, risobanurwa ngo: “Namukuye mu mazi.”
Igihe kimwe, Mose amaze gukura, aja aho abantu bo mu bwoko bwiwe baba, abona n’ibikorwa biruhije bariko barakora. Niho yabona Umunyegiputa ariko arakubita Umuheburayo w’iwabo.
Amaze kuraba hirya no hino akabona ko ata n’umwe amubona, aca yica wa Munyegiputa, ikiziga ciwe akinyegeza mu musenyi.
Bukeye bw’aho asubiyeyo, abona Abaheburayo babiri bariko baragwana. Nuko abaza uwatanguye mugenziwe ati: “Ni kubera iki uriko urakubita Umuheburayo mwenewanyu?”
Na we aramwishura ati: “Ni nde yakugize umutware n’umucamanza wacu? Ugomba kunyica nk’uko wishe wa Munyegiputa?” Kuva ubwo Mose aca agira ubwoba yiyumvira ati: “Bwabundi ivyo nakoze vyaramenyekanye.”
Maze Farawo avyumvise, aca arondera ingene yokwica Mose, ariko Mose aramuhunga aja kuba mu karere ka Midiyani. Ashitseyo aja kwicara kw’iriba.
Kandi, hariho umuherezi w’i Midiyani yari afise abakobwa indwi, maze baza kuvoma amazi ngo buzuze ubwato ibitungwa vya sewabo binywe.
Nuko abandi bungere baca baraza, barabirukana, ariko Mose arahaguruka arabagwanira, banywesha ibitungwa vyabo.
Ba bakobwa batashe, se Reyuweli, arababaza ati: “Vyagenze gute ko mutashe kare uno musi?”
Na bo baramwishura bati: “Hari Umunyegiputa yadukingiye abungere, yongera atuvomera amazi duca tunywesha umukuku.”
Aca arababaza ati: “None ari hehe? Ni kubera iki mwamusizeyo? Nimumuhamagare tumufungurire.”
Nuko Mose aremera ubutumire, aca agumaho, abana na bo. Haheze igihe Reyuweli amuha umukobwa wiwe yitwa Zipora, aba umugore wiwe.
Hanyuma Zipora avyara umwana w’umuhungu, Mose amwita Gerishomu, risobanurwa ngo: “Nabaye akavantara mu gihugu kitari ic’iwacu.”
Haciye ikindi gihe kirekire, umwami wa Egiputa arapfa. Abisirayeli batakambishwa n’imibabaro y’ubuja barimwo, bararira, maze ugutaka kwabo kuraduga gushikira Imana.
Imana yumva amaborogo yabo, maze yibuka isezerano yasezeraniye Aburahamu na Isaka na Yakobo.
Iravye Abisirayeli, bayitera akagongwe.
Umusi umwe, Mose yari aragiye intama za sebukwe Yetiro, umuherezi w’i Midiyani, hanyuma azijana kure hirya y’ubugaragwa, ashika i Horebu, ku musozi w’Imana.
Maze umumarayika w’ Uhoraho aramwiyereka ari mu rubeya rw’umuriro wakira mu gisaka. Mose yegereye ngo arabe, abona ico gisaka caka ariko kidatemuka.
Aca yibwira ati: “Reka negere ndabe ibi bitangaza. Ni kuki iki gisaka caka kidatemuka?”
Uhoraho abonye Mose agiye kwegera ngo arabe, Imana ica iramuhamagara iri muri ca gisaka, iti: “Mose! Mose!” Mose na we ati: “Sabwe!”
Iramubwira iti: “Ntiwegere hano hantu! Ambura ibirato vyawe kuko aha uhagaze ari ahera.”
Yongera imubwira iti: “Ndi Imana ya ba sogokuruza, Imana ya Aburahamu, Imana ya Isaka n’Imana ya Yakobo.” Mose yumvise ivyo aca yipfuka mu maso kuko atinye kuraba Imana.

Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Niboneye amagorwa ubwoko bwanje burimwo muri Egiputa. Niyumviye amarira yabo avuye ku mibabaro bariko barababazwa n’ababategeka, kandi banteye akagongwe ku bw’iyo mibabaro barimwo.
None rero manutse kubatabara, ndabakize amaboko y’Abanyegiputa, ndabatware mu gihugu ciza, gitemba amata n’ubuki, igihugu c’Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abamori, Abaperizi, Abahiwi, n’Abayebusi.
Amarira y’Abisirayeli yanshikiriye, kandi nabonye ingene Abanyegiputa babatwaza umukazo.
None rero genda, ndakurungitse kuri Farawo kugira ngo ukure abantu banje b’Abisirayeli muri Egiputa.”
Ariko Mose yishura ati: “Mbega jewe ndi iki aho undungika kuri Farawo ngo nkure Abisirayeli muri Egiputa?”
Imana iramwishura iti: “Nzoba ndi kumwe nawe. Kandi iki ni co kimenyetso kizokwemeza ko ari jewe ndakurungitse: Niwakura abantu banje muri Egiputa, muzonsengera kuri uwu musozi.”
Mose abwira Imana ati: “Ninaja mu Bisirayeli nkababwira nti: ‘Imana ya ba sogokuruza yabantumyeko,’ hanyuma bakambaza bati: ‘Izina ryayo yitwa nde?’ Nzobishura gute?”
Imana ibarira Mose iti: “ Ndi uwo Ndi we . Uku abe ari ko uzobwira Abisirayeli, uti ‘ Ndiho yabantumyeko.’ ”

Imana yongera kubwira Mose iti: Uze ubwire Abisirayeli uti: “ Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza, Imana ya Aburahamu, ya Isaka na Yakobo yabantumyeko. Iryo ni ryo zina ryanje ibihe vyose, izina nzokwibukirwako uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikirana.
Genda wegeranye abakuru b’Abisirayeli, ubabwire uti: ‘ Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza, Imana ya Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo yaranyiyeretse imbwira iti: Narihweje mbona uko Abanyegiputa babacunaguza.
Kandi nasezeranye ko nzobakiza agacinyizo murimwo muri Egiputa nkabatwara mu gihugu c’Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abamori, Abaperizi, Abahiwi, n’Abayebusi, iguhugu gitemba amata n’ubuki.’

Abakuru b’Abisirayeli bazokwumvira. Hanyuma mwe na bo, muzoce mugenda ku mwami wa Egiputa mumubarire muti: ‘ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abaheburayo yatwiyeretse. Tureke dufate urugendo rw’imisi itatu mu bugaragwa, tuje gushikanira ibimazi Uhoraho Imana yacu.’
Ariko ndazi ko umwami wa Egiputa atazobarekura, kiretse ukuboko kw’inkomezi kumugondoje.
Ico gihe nzoramvura ukuboko kwanje nkubitishe Abanyegiputa ibitangaza vyose nzobakoreramwo. Hanyuma y’ivyo, azoca abarekura mugende.
Nzotuma Abanyegiputa babaraba ijisho ryiza, kugira ngo nimwagenda ntimuzogende iminwe misa.

Umugore w’Umwisirayelikazi wese azosabe umubanyi wiwe w’Umunyegiputakazi canke uwundi wese aba mu nzu yiwe utugenegene ducuzwe mu nzahabu canke mw’ifeza, n’impuzu muzokwambika abahungu n’abakobwa banyu. Uko ni ko muzonyaga itunga Abanyegiputa.”

headings.text: Mose abona igisaka caka ariko ntikirurumbe

verses.text: Mose abaza Imana ati: “Nibatanyizera canke ngo banyumvirize, bakavuga bati: ‘ Uhoraho ntiyakwiyeretse’ na ho bizogenda gute?”
Uhoraho aca amubaza ati: “Ico ufise mu minwe ni igiki?” Na we arishura ati: “Ni inkoni.”
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Yiterere hasi.” Nuko Mose ayiterera hasi ica ihinduka inzoka, na we arayihunga.
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Ramvura ukuboko kwawe uyifate ku murizo.” Mose aramvura ukuboko afata ya nzoka ku murizo, ica isubira kuba inkoni mu ntoke ziwe.
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Iki ni co kizobabera ikimenyetso kugira ngo bizere ko Uhoraho , Imana ya ba sogokuruza, Imana ya Aburahamu, ya Isaka na Yakobo yakwiyeretse.”
Uhoraho arongera avuga ati: “Shira ukuboko mu gikiriza cawe.” Nuko Mose agushirayo, agukuyeyo asanga kwuzuyeko imibembe, kwera derere.
Uhoraho yongera kumubwira ati: “Gusubize mu gikiriza cawe.” Mose agusubizayo, agukuyeyo asanga kwakize, kumeze neza co kimwe n’ahandi hose ku mubiri wiwe.
Uhoraho aramubwira ati: “Nibatakwemera canke ngo bemezwe n’ikimenyetso ca mbere, bazokwemezwa n’ica kabiri.
Ariko nibatemezwa n’ibi bimenyetso vyompi canke ngo bakwumvirize, uzodahe amazi y’uruzi Nili uyasese i musozi. Amazi uzoba wadashe muri urwo ruzi niwayasuka hasi, azoca ahinduka amaraso.”

Mose aca abarira Uhoraho ati: “Ewe Mana, babarira umusavyi wawe. Jewe sinigeze mba umuntu ashize amanga mu kuvuga, kandi ni kuva kera kugeza n’ubu aho uriko uravugisha umusavyi wawe, ntakirahinduka. Birangora kuvuga.”
Uhoraho aramubaza ati: “Mbega ni nde aha abantu akanwa? Ni nde atuma batumva canke akabagira ibiragi? Ni nde abaha kubona canke akabagira impumyi? Mbega si jewe Uhoraho ?
Nuko rero genda, nzogufasha kuvuga, kandi nzokwigisha ivyo uzovuga.”
Ariko Mose aravuga ati: “Mwami, ndakwinginze urungike uwundi.”

Maze uburake bw’ Uhoraho buca buziriringira Mose, ariko aramubaza ati: “Mbega Aroni, Umulewi mukurwawe si ho ari? Ndazi ko azi kuvuga neza. Ariko araza kugira ngo muhure, kandi umutima wiwe uzonezerwa niyakubona.
Uzomubwira, ushire amajambo avuga mu kanwa kiwe; nanje nzobafasha mwempi, kandi nzobigisha ivyo mukora.
We azoba umuvugizi wawe imbere y’abantu, kandi azoba nk’aho ari akanwa kawe, nawe uzoba uri mu kibanza c’Imana, umubwira ico avuga.
Kandi, witwaze n’iyo nkoni ufise mu minwe kugira ngo uzoyikoreshe vya bitangaza.”
Mose aca asubira kwa sebukwe Yetiro, aramubarira ati: “Ndekura ngende kuraba ab’ubwoko bwacu muri Egiputa, ndabe ko boba bakiriho.” Yetiro aramwishura ati: “Genda amahoro.”
Imbere y’uko Mose ava i Midiyani, Uhoraho yari yamubwiye ati: “Subira muri Egiputa, kuko abagomba kukwica bose bapfuye.”
Maze Mose afata umugore n’abana biwe, aburiza indogoba, afata urugendo ruja muri Egiputa, kandi agenda yitwaje na ya nkoni y’Imana mu minwe.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Niwashika muri Egiputa, uzokorere imbere ya Farawo vya bitangaza naguha ububasha bwo gukora. Ariko nzokomantaza umutima wiwe kugira ngo ntarekure abantu banje ngo bagende.
Farawo uzomubwire aya majambo uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Isirayeli ni umuhungu wanje w’imfura.
Narakubwiye rero, nti rekura umuhungu wanje agende kunsenga; ariko waranse kumurekura. None rero nzokwica umuhungu wawe w’imfura.’ ”
Akiri ku rugendo aja muri Egiputa, Uhoraho asanga Mose aho yari yasavye indaro n’umuryango wiwe, agomba kumwica.
Maze umugore wiwe Zipora aca afata ibuye rikarishe, akeba umubiri upfutse kw’isonga ry’igitsina c’umuhungu wiwe, aca agikoza ku maguru ya Mose, avuga ati: “Ni ivy’ukuri uri umugabo wanje w’amaraso.”
Uhoraho aca aramureka. (Aho yavuga ngo: “Uri umugabo wanje w’amaraso,” yari afatiye ku gukebwa.)
Uhoraho abarira Aroni ati: “Fata inzira uje mu bugaragwa, uhure na Mose.” Maze Aroni afata inzira, aragenda ahurira na Mose ku musozi w’Imana, baragumbirana.
Maze Mose abarira Aroni ivyo Uhoraho yamutumye kuzovuga vyose, amubwira n’ibitangaza yamubwiye kuzokora.
Mose na Aroni baca baragenda, bakoranya abakuru b’Abisirayeli bose;
Aroni ababwira ivyo Uhoraho yabwiye Mose vyose. Yongera akorera vya bitangaza imbere yabo,
na bo baramwizera. Bumvise ko Uhoraho yabagiriye impuhwe akabona imibabaro barimwo, baca barapfukama baramusenga.
Inyuma y’ivyo, Mose na Aroni baja kwa Farawo baramubwira bati: “ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abisirayeli avuze ngo: ‘Rekura abantu banje baje kungirira imisi mikuru mu bugaragwa.’ ”
Farawo arabishura ati: “ Uhoraho ni nde aho ndamwumvira nkareka Abisirayeli ngo bagende? Uhoraho nta we nzi, kandi sindabarekura ngo bagende.”

Na bo baramwishura bati: “Imana y’Abaheburayo yaratwiyeretse. Tureke rero dufate urugendo rw’imisi itatu, tuje mu bugaragwa gushikanira ibimazi Uhoraho Imana yacu, kuko bitabaye gutyo yotumarisha ivyago canke inkota.”
Ariko umwami wa Egiputa arabishura ati: “Mose na Aroni, ni igiki gitumye mutera abantu ubunebwe, mukabatesha ibikorwa vyabo? Nimusubire ku bikorwa vyanyu!”
Yongerako ati: “Raba abantu banyu baragwiriye muri iki gihugu, none muriko murababuza gukora!”
Uwo musi nyene Farawo aca aha itegeko abantu bakoresha abagurano b’Abisirayeli ati:
“Ntimuzosubire kubaha ivyatsi vyo gukoresha mu kubumba amatafari, kuva ubu ni bo bazohora bavyironderera,
kandi igitigiri c’amatafari bahora babumba ntikizogabanywa. Ni abanebwe, ni co gituma bariko barikomesha induru bavuga ngo: ‘Tureke tuje gushikanira Imana yacu ibimazi.’
Nimubongerereze ibikorwa kugira ngo bagume bakora ntibaronke akanya ko kwumviriza amajambo y’ibinyoma.”
Abo bakoresha abagurano baca baragenda babwira abantu bati: “Uku ni ko Farawo avuze: Sinzosubira kubaha ivyatsi vyo gukoresha mu kubumba amatafari.
Nabe ari mwebwe mwironderera iyo mubikura, ariko igitigiri c’amatafari mwahora mukora ku musi ntikizogabanuka.”
Maze abantu bose bakwiragira Egiputa begeranya ivyatsi vyo gukoresha.
Ababakoresha babandanya babacunaguza, bababwira bati: “Mutegerezwa gukwiza igitigiri c’amatafari mwahora mubumba babahaye ivyatsi mukoresha.”

Hanyuma abakozi ba Farawo bakoresha abagurano bagakubita Abisirayeli bashizeho ngo barongore benewabo, bababaza bati: “Ni kubera iki mutakwije igitigiri c’amatafari mwategerezwa kubumba, haba ejo canke uwu musi nk’uko mwahora?”
Maze abo barongozi b’Abisirayeli baca baja kwitwara kwa Farawo bavuga bati: “Ni iki catumye udukorera ibi, twebwe abasavyi bawe?
Nta vyatsi duhabwa, ariko tukabwirwa ngo ‘Bumba amatafari!’ Twebwe abasavyi bawe twirirwa turakubitwa; ivy’abantu bawe badukorera ni akarenganyo.”
Farawo arabishura ati: “Mwa binebwe mwe! Muri ibinebwe, ni co gituma mwama muvuga ngo ‘Tureke tuje gushikanira ibimazi Uhoraho .’
Subira ku bikorwa! Nta vyatsi muzoronswa, kandi mutegerezwa gukwiza igitigiri c’amatafari mwategetswe.”
Abarongozi b’Abisirayeli baca barabona noneho ko bagowe cane babwiwe ko ata musi n’umwe bazobura gushitsa igitigiri c’amatafari bagenewe kubumba.
Bavuye kwa Farawo, basanga Mose na Aroni babarindiririye hanze.
Abo barongozi babwira Mose na Aroni bati: “ Uhoraho abone ivyo mwatugiriye maze abahane. Mwatumye Farawo n’abantu biwe batuzinukwa, mwashize inkota mu biganza vyabo ngo batwice.”
Maze Mose ahindukirira Uhoraho aravuga ati: “Ewe Mana, ni iki gitumye utera amagorwa aba bantu? Iki ni co catumye undungika?
Igihe cose nagiye kwa Farawo mw’izina ryawe, yababereye mubi gusumba uko yahora, kandi nawe ntaco wigeze ukora kugira ngo ubatabare.”
Maze Uhoraho abarira Mose iti: “Rindira gato wirabire ivyo nkorera Farawo. Ku bw’ukuboko kwanje kw’inkomezi, azobarekura bagende; ku bw’ukuboko kwanje kw’inkomezi, azobirukana bave mu gihugu ciwe.”
Imana yongera iramubwira iti: “Ndi Uhoraho .
Niyeretse Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo, ndabiyereka nk’Imana Mushoboravyose, ariko sinigeze ndabibwira muri iryo zina ryanje ari ryo Uhoraho .
Kandi nabasezeraniye ko nzobaha igihugu c’i Kanani, ico babayemwo nk’abanyamahanga.
Icongeyeko narumvise amarira y’abantu banje bari mu buja muri Egiputa, nca nibuka isezerano nabasezeraniye.

None rero barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Ndi Uhoraho , nzobakura musi y’agacinyizo k’Abanyegiputa. Nzobabohora mureke kubabera abagurano, nzogorora ukuboko kwanje ndabacungure nkoreshe n’ibikorwa bikomeye bigaragaza urubanza mbaciriye.
Nzobagira abantu banje, nanje nzoba Imana yanyu. Ni ho muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu nabakuye mu gacinyizo k’Abanyegiputa.
Nzobajana mu gihugu narahiye manitse ukuboko ko nzogiha Aburahamu, Isaka na Yakobo. Nzokibaha kibe inyegu yanyu. Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze.’ ”
Maze Mose yiganira Abisirayeli ivyo Imana yamubwiye, ariko ntibamwumviriza kuko bari baciwe intege n’agacinyizo gahambaye barimwo.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Genda ubarire Farawo umwami wa Egiputa arekure Abisirayeli bave muri iki gihugu.”
Ariko Mose abarira Uhoraho ati: “Nimba Abisirayeli batanyumviriza, mbega Farawo yonyumviriza gute ntazi no kuvuga?”
Maze Uhoraho avugana na Mose na Aroni, ababwira ivyo babwira Abisirayeli na Farawo umwami wa Egiputa, ngo bakure Abisirayeli muri Egiputa.
Aba ni bo baserukira imiryango yabo: Bene Reyubeni ari we mfura mu bahungu ba Isirayeli bari aba: Enoki, Palu, Hezironi na Karumi. Abo ni bo bari bagize imiryango ya Reyubeni.
Bene Simeyoni bari: Yemuweli, Yamini, Ohadi, Yakini, Zohari na Sawuli yavyaye ku Munyakananikazi. Abo na bo bari bagize imiryango ya Simiyoni.
Aya ni yo mazina y’abahungu ba Lewi nk’uko vyanditswe: Gerishoni, Kohati, na Merari. (Lewi yamaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itatu n’indwi.)
Abahungu ba Gerishoni uko imiryango yabo yari imeze ni: Libuni na Shimeyi.
Abahungu ba Kohati bari aba: Amuramu, Izihari, Heburoni na Uziyeli. (Kohati yamaze imyaka ijana na mirongo itatu n’itatu.)
Abahungu ba Merari bari aba: Mahuli na Mushi. Iyo ni yo miryango ya Lewi uko yanditswe:
Amuramu yarongoye mushiki wa se yitwa Yokebedi, bavyarana Aroni na Mose. (Amuramu yabayeho imyaka ijana na mirongo itatu n’indwi.)
Abahungu ba Izihari bari aba: Kora, Nefegi na Zikuri.
Abahungu ba Uziyeli bari aba: Mishayeli, Elizafani, na Situri.
Aroni yarongoye Elisheba umukobwa wa Aminadabu akaba na mushiki wa Nahashoni, bavyarana Nadabu, Abihu, Eliyazeri na Itamari.
Abahungu ba Kora bari aba: Asiri, Elukana, na Abiyasafu. Ni bo bari bagize imiryango ya Kora.
Eliyazeri mwene Aroni yarongoye umwe mu bakobwa ba Putiyeli, bavyarana Finehasi. Abo ni bo bari abakuru b’imiryango ikomoka kuri Lewi, ukurikije abakuru b’amazu.
Uwo Aroni nyene na Mose ni bo Uhoraho yabwiye ati: “Kura Abisirayeli muri Egiputa uko imiryango yabo iri.”
Ni bo babwiye Farawo umwami wa Egiputa ngo arekure Abisirayeli.
Igihe Uhoraho yavugana na Mose ari muri Egiputa yamubwiye ati:
“Ndi Uhoraho . Genda ubwire Farawo umwami wa Egiputa ivyo ndakubariye vyose.”
Ariko Mose abwira Uhoraho ati: “Mbega ko ntazi no kuvuga, ni igiki cotuma Farawo anyumvira?”

headings.text: Ba sekuruza ba Mose na Aroni
Aroni avuga mu kibanza ca Mose

verses.text: Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ehe nakugize nk’Imana kuri Farawo, Aroni na we ndamugira nk’umuvugishwa wawe.
Nimugende mumubwire ivyo ndagutegeka vyose, Aroni na we abarire Farawo arekure Abisirayeli bave mu gihugu ciwe.
Ariko nzokomantaza umutima wa Farawo, hanyuma ngwize ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso vyanje muri Egiputa.

Ndetse n’aho nyene, Farawo ntazobumvira. Ariko Egiputa nzohakubitisha ukuboko kwanje hamwe n’ibikorwa vyanje vy’inkomezi, maze ndokore ingabo zanje ari bo Bisirayeli, ndabakuze muri ico gihugu ibihano bikomeye.
Kandi Abanyegiputa bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho ninaramvurira ukuboko kwanje kuri Egiputa ngakurayo Abisirayeli.”
Mose na Aroni babikora uko Uhoraho yabibabwiye.
Igihe bavugana na Farawo, Mose yari afise imyaka mirongo umunani, Aroni na we yari afise imyaka mirongo umunani n’itatu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati:
“Farawo niyababwira ngo mukore igitangaza, muzofate iyo nkoni muyiterere imbere yiwe, izoca ihinduka inzoka.”
Nuko Mose na Aroni baca baja kwa Farawo, babigenza nk’uko nyene Uhoraho yabibategetse. Aroni aterera ya nkoni imbere ya Farawo n’abantu biwe, ica ihinduka inzoka.
Farawo na we aca atumako ba kamenyi n’abapfumu biwe, maze abo ba kamenyi b’Abanyegiputa na bo baca bakora ikimenyetso gisa n’ico nyene bakoresheje amareba yabo,
baterera inkoni zabo hasi zica zicika inzoka. Ariko ya nkoni ya Aroni ica imiragura za nkoni zabo.
Farawo akomantaza umutima, ntiyabumvira nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabivuze.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Umutima wa Farawo wakomantaye. Yanse kurekura abantu ngo bagende.
Muzoje kumuraba ejo mu gatondo agiye ku ruzi. Muzomutegerere ku nkengera y’uruzi Nili, muzogende mujanye na ya nkoni yacika inzoka.
Muzomubwire muti: ‘ Uhoraho , Imana y’Abaheburayo yakudutumyeko ngo rekura abantu biwe bagende, kugira ngo baje kumusengera mu bugaragwa. Kandi gushika ubu wanse kumwumvira.
None rero uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Iki ni co kigiye kukwereka ko ndi Uhoraho : Ngira nkubitishe iyi nkoni uruzi Nili, ruce ruhinduka amaraso.
Amafi yo mu ruzi azoca apfa, kandi uruzi ruzonuka. Abanyegiputa ntibazoba bagisubira kunywa amazi yarwo.’ ”

Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Barira Aroni uti: ‘Fata inkoni yawe, uramvure ukuboko hejuru y’amazi ya Egiputa: inzuzi zaho zose, imigende, ayari mu binogo, n’ayari mu bushinguro, yose aca acika amaraso. Amaraso aca aba ahantu hose muri Egiputa, no mu bivomesho bikozwe mu biti canke mu mabuye.’ ”
Mose na Aroni baca babikora uko Uhoraho yabibategetse. Aroni aramvura ya nkoni ari imbere ya Farawo n’abatware biwe, akubita amazi y’uruzi Nili, ubwo nyene amazi aca ahinduka amaraso.
Amafi yo muri urwo ruzi aca arapfa, amazi aranuka, Abanyegiputa ntibaba bagishobora kuyanywa. Maze amaraso yuzura hose muri Egiputa.
Na ho nyene abanyamareba b’Abanyegiputa bakora ibisa n’ivyo, umutima wa Farawo uca urakomantara, yanka kwumvira Mose na Aroni nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabivuze.
Farawo aca asubira ku kirimba, ntiyanashira umutima ku vyabaye.
Maze Abanyegiputa bimba ibinogo i ruhande y’uruzi barondera amazi, kuko batashobora kunywa amazi y’urwo ruzi.
Nuko haca imisi indwi Uhoraho ateye ico cago urwo ruzi Nili.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Genda ubarire Farawo uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Rekura abantu banje bagende, baje kunsenga.
Nutabarekura, nzotera icago c’ibikere mu gihugu cose.

Uruzi Nili ruzokwuzura ibikere. Bizova mu ruzi bishike no ku kirimba cawe, ndetse bishike no mu cumba cawe uryamamwo, mbere no ku buriri bwawe, mu mazu y’abatware bawe n’ay’abantu bawe, bishike mu maziko no mu bwato mucumbiramwo imikate.
Bizokwurirako, vyurire ku bantu bawe, no ku batware bawe.’ ”
Uhoraho aca abarira Mose ati: “Barira Aroni uti: ‘Ramvurira iyo nkoni ufise mu kuboko kwawe hejuru y’inzuzi, imigende n’ibinogo vy’amazi, kugira ngo igihugu ca Egiputa cuzure ibikere.’ ”
Nuko Aroni aramvurira ukuboko hejuru y’amazi ya Egiputa, aca avamwo ibikere vyuzura igihugu cose.
Ariko abanyamareba baca bakora ibisa nk’ivyo, batuma ibikere biza mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Farawo aca ahamagaza Mose na Aroni, arababarira ati: “Nimunsabire Uhoraho akure ibi bikere mu rugo rwanje no mu bantu banje, ndaheza ndekure abantu banyu baje kumushikanira ibimazi.”
Mose abarira Farawo ati: “Nyakwubahwa, ndagusavye wewe umbarire igihe nogusabira kugira ngo ibikere vyose bikurwe mu kirimba cawe, mu batware bawe no mu bantu bawe, hasigare ivyo mu ruzi Nili gusa.”
Farawo aramwishura ati: “Uzobikore ejo.” Mose aramwishura ati: “Bizoba uko nyene ubivuze kugira ngo umenye ko ata wuhwanye n’ Uhoraho Imana yacu.
Ibikere bizova mu kirimba cawe no mu mazu y’abatware bawe n’ay’abantu bawe, hazosigara ibiri mu ruzi Nili gusa.”
Nuko Mose na Aroni baca bava ku kirimba kwa Farawo, Mose atakambira Uhoraho ku bw’ibikere yari yateje Farawo.
Maze Uhoraho akora ivyo Mose amusavye. Ibikere vyose vyari mu mazu, mu gahinga no mu mirima birapfa.
Bavyegeraniriza mu birundo, umunuko ukwira igihugu cose.
Ariko Farawo abonye agahengwe kabonetse, aca akomantaza umutima, ntiyumvira Mose na Aroni, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabivuze.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Barira Aroni uti: ‘Ramvura inkoni yawe, ukubite umukungugu wo hasi, umukungugu wose wo muri Egiputa uca ucika imibu.’ ”
Baca babikora uko nyene, Aroni amaze kuramvura ukuboko kwiwe agakubita umukungugu, haciye haduka imibu irya abantu n’ibitungwa. Umukungugu wose wo muri Egiputa wacitse imibu.
Abanyamareba na bo nyene bagerageza kuzana imibu bakoresheje amareba yabo, ariko ntibabishobora. Maze imibu ikwira mu bantu no mu bitungwa.
Abanyamareba ba Farawo baca bamubwira bati: “Uru ni urutoke rw’Imana rukoze ibi.” Ariko Farawo akomantaza umutima yanka kwumvira, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabivuze.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Uzozinduke ejo mu gatondo, uhangane na Farawo agiye ku ruzi, umubwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: Rekura abantu banje, kugira ngo baje kunsenga.
Nutabarekura, nzoguteza ibibugu, ndabiteze n’abatware bawe, ndabiteze abantu bawe, eka mbere n’abo mu mazu yawe. Amazu y’Abanyegiputa azokwuzura ibibugu, bipfuke n’isi yose ya Egiputa.’
Ariko ico gihe nzosigaza intara ya Gosheni, iyo abantu banje babamwo, nta bibugu bizobayo, kugira ngo umenye ko jewe Uhoraho ndi muri iki gihugu.
Nzoshira itandukaniro hagati y’abantu bawe n’abantu banje. Ibi bitangaza bizoshika ejo.”
Maze Uhoraho abikora nk’uko yari yabivuze. Ibibugu bitagira igitigiri vyuzura mu kirimba kwa Farawo no mu mazu y’abatware biwe, ndetse n’igihugu cose ca Egiputa giterwa n’ico cago c’ibibugu.
Farawo araheza ahamagaza Mose na Aroni ababarira ati: “Nimugende mushikanire Imana yanyu ibimazi, ariko muyibishikanire muri iki gihugu nyene.”

Ariko Mose amwishura ati: “Twoba dukoze ikizira. Ibimazi dushikanira Uhoraho Imana yacu ni ikizira mu maso y’Abanyegiputa. Kandi nimba ibimazi vyacu ari ikizira mu maso yabo, mbega ntibodutera amabuye?
Dutegerezwa gufata urugendo rw’imisi itatu mu bugaragwa tugiye gushikanira ibimazi Uhoraho Imana yacu nk’uko yabidutegetse.”
Farawo aramubwira ati: “Ndabareka muje gushikanira ibimazi Uhoraho Imana yanyu mu bugaragwa, ariko ntimushike kure! Nanje munsengere.”

Mose aramwishura ati: “Nitwamara gutandukana, nca nsenga Uhoraho , ejo ibibugu bizova iwawe, ku batware bawe no mu bantu bawe. Ariko wiyubare ntusubire kuduhenda ngo ubuze abantu kuja gushikanira ibimazi Uhoraho .”
Mose atandukana na Farawo, hanyuma aca asenga Uhoraho ,
na we akora ivyo Mose amusavye. Akura ibibugu mu kirimba ca Farawo no mu mazu y’abatware biwe n’ay’abantu biwe, ntihagira ikibugu na kimwe gisigara.
Ariko na ho nyene Farawo asubira gukomantaza umutima, yankira abantu ko bagenda.
Uhoraho abwira Mose ati: “Genda ubarire Farawo uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho Imana y’Abaheburayo avuze: “Rekura abantu banje baje kunsenga.”
Nutabarekura ngo bagende ukabagumiza ngaho,
ikiganza c’ Uhoraho kizozana ivyago ku bitungwa vyanyu aho biri hose ku misozi: ku mafarasi, ku ndogoba, ku ngamiya, ku nka zanyu, ku mpene no ku ntama.
Ariko Uhoraho azoshiraho itandukaniro hagati y’amasho y’Abisirayeli n’ay’Abanyegiputa, kugira ngo ntihagire igitungwa na kimwe c’Abisirayeli gipfa.
Uhoraho yamaze gushinga igihe ivyo bizobera. Ico cago kizoshika muri iki gihugu ejo.’ ”
Bukeye Uhoraho arabishitsa, ibitungwa vyose vyo muri Egiputa birapfa, ariko nta na kimwe c’Abisirayeli capfuye.
Maze Farawo arungika abantu biwe kuraba ingene vyagenze, basanga nta gitungwa na kimwe c’Abisirayeli capfuye. Ariko umutima wiwe uguma ukomantaye, yanka kurekura abantu ngo bagende.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati: “Nimufate umunyota wo mw’itanure wuzuye igipfunsi, maze Mose awutumurire mu kirere imbere ya Farawo.
Uzoheza ucike umukungugu kuri Egiputa, ukwire igihugu cose, ku bantu bose no ku bikoko vyose, ubatere ibisebe.”
Nuko baca bafata umunyota wo mw’itanure, bahagarara imbere ya Farawo, bawutumurira mu kirere, ubwo nyene abantu n’ibikoko bigwara ibisebe.
Abanyamareba ntibaba bagishobora guhagarara imbere ya Farawo kuko ibisebe vyari vyateye Abanyegiputa bose.
Ariko Uhoraho akomantaza umutima wa Farawo, yanka kwumvira Mose na Aroni, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yabibwiye Mose.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Uzozinduke mu gatondo ka kare, ugende uhangane na Farawo umubwire uti: ‘Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abaheburayo avuze: Rekura abantu banje bagende, baje kunsenga,
kuko nutabarekura nzorungika ibindi vyago bikomeye kuri wewe, ku batware bawe no ku bantu bawe, kugira ngo umenye ko ata wuhwanye nanje kw’isi yose.
Kugeza ubu nari kuba naragororeye ukuboko kwanje kuri wewe no ku bantu bawe nkabaranduza icago maze nkabaherengeteza kw’isi.
Ariko, icatumye nkureka, kwari ukugira ngo nkwereke ububasha bwanje, kandi kugira ngo izina ryanje rimenyekane kw’isi yose.
Mugabo, uracakomantaje umutima, ntugomba kubarekura ngo bagende.
None rero, ejo nzorungika icago c’urubura rutari bwakaboneke, rutari bwigere rugwa muri Egiputa kuva iki gihugu kibayeho.
Tumako ibitungwa vyawe biri mu gahinga bije mu mpongore, kuko urubura ruzogwa ku bantu bose no ku bikoko vyose bitazoba vyugamye, kandi bizopfa.’ ”
Bamwe mu batware ba Farawo bubashe ijambo ry’ Uhoraho baca bihutira gucura abagurano babo n’ibitungwa vyabo baravyugamika.
Ariko abatashize umutima kw’ijambo ry’ Uhoraho bagumiza abagurano babo n’ibitungwa vyabo mu gahinga.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Gorora ukuboko ukurabisha kw’ijuru, maze urubura ruraheza rugwe mu gihugu cose ca Egiputa, rugwe ku bantu, ku bikoko no ku bimera vyose vyo mu mirima ya Egiputa.”
Mose aramvuye ya nkoni ayirabishije mu kirere, Uhoraho aca arungika imituragaro n’urubura, imiravyo irabagiriza kw’isi. Uhoraho agwisha urubura mu gihugu cose ca Egiputa.
Muri kahise ka Egiputa, ntihari bwigere hagwa imvura y’igihuhusi nk’iyo, irimwo urubura rutikiza n’imiravyo irabagiza nk’uko.
Urubura rurarundana muri Egiputa hose, rutikiza ivyari mu mirima vyose, uhereye ku bantu ugashitsa no ku bitungwa, rutikiza imirima n’ibiti vyose.
Akarere rutaguyemwo ni Gosheni honyene, aho Abisirayeli baba.
Maze Farawo ahamagaza Mose na Aroni arababwira ati: “Ubu ho nacumuye. Uhoraho ni we agororotse, twe n’abantu banje twakoze ibibi.
None rero dusabire k’ Uhoraho , kuko urubura n’imituragaro bitewe n’Imana biturembeje. Nca ndabarekura mugende, sinsubira kubafatira.”
Mose aramwishura ati: “Ninamara kuva muri iki gisagara ndaza kuramvura ibiganza nsenge Uhoraho . Imituragaro iraza guhera, kandi nta rubura rusubira kugwa, ni ho uza kumenya ko isi ari iy’ Uhoraho .
Ariko ndazi ko mwe n’abatware bawe mutubaha Uhoraho Imana.”
Ibiterwa vyose vyari vyatikijwe n’urubura, ivyari biyangitse na sayiri zari zipfunditse.
Ariko ingano z’ubwoko butandukanye nta co zabaye kuko ziteba kumera.
Maze Mose ava imbere ya Farawo, aja inyuma y’igisagara. Aramvura amaboko ayerekeje k’ Uhoraho , imituragaro n’urubura birahagarara, imvura ntiyasubira kugwa.
Farawo abonye ko imvura, imituragaro n’urubura vyahagaze, yongera akora icaha. We n’abatware biwe bongera gukomantaza imitima.
Kubera ko umutima wiwe wari wakomantaye, ntiyemerera Abisirayeli ko bagenda, nk’uko Uhoraho yari yarabivugishije Mose.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Subira uje kwa Farawo, kuko nakomantaje umutima wiwe n’uw’abatware biwe, kugira ngo mbashe kwerekana ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza vyanje
kandi kugira ngo muzobwire abana n’abuzukuru banyu ingene nahanye nivuye inyuma Abanyegiputa, eka n’ibitangaza nakoreye hagati muri bo kugira ngo mumenye ko ndi Uhoraho .”
Nuko Mose na Aroni baja kwa Farawo, baramubwira bati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho , Imana y’Abaheburayo, avuze: Uzogeza ryari gukomantaza umutima imbere yanje? Rekura abantu banje baje kunsenga.
Nutabarekura, ejo nzorekurira inzige ku gihugu cawe.
Zizopfuka isi gushika aho ata wuzoshobora no kubona hasi. Zizotikiza utwasigajwe n’urubura, harimwo n’igiti cose co mw’ishamba.
Zizokwuzura mu mazu yawe n’ay’abatware bawe, n’ay’Abanyegiputa bose. Kizoba icago ba sogokuru na ba sogokuruza batari bwigere babona.” Mose aca asubira inyuma, atandukana na Farawo.
Abatware ba Farawo na bo bamubwira bati: “Mbega uzogeza ryari kureka uwo mugabo ngo agume aduta mu mutego? Rekura abo bantu bagende gusenga Uhoraho Imana yabo. Ntubona ko Egiputa hatikiye?”
Nuko Mose na Aroni bagarukanwa imbere ya Farawo, na we arababwira ati: “Nimugende musenge Uhoraho Imana yanyu. Ariko rero mbarira: Ni ba nde muzojana?”
Mose na we aramwishura ati: “Tuzojana n’abakiri bato n’abakuze, abahungu n’abakobwa bacu, n’ibitungwa vyacu, kuko tuzoba tugiye kwigina Uhoraho .”
Farawo arababwira ati: “ Uhoraho arabana namwe, ninabareka mukajana n’abagore n’abana banyu! Biraboneka ko mufise intumbero mbi.
Ntibikabe! Nimujane n’abagabo gusa, musenge Uhoraho , kuko ari co mwagumye munsaba.” Nuko Mose na Aroni baca barirukanwa, bava imbere ya Farawo.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ramvurira ukuboko kwawe kuri Egiputa uhamagare inzige. Zize zipfuke isi, zitikize igiterwa cose casigajwe n’urubura.”

Mose aramvurira ya nkoni yiwe kuri Egiputa, Uhoraho na we ahuhutisha umuyaga uvuye mu buseruko, uhuhuta mu gihugu cose, ijoro n’umurango. Bukeye mu gatondo, wa muyaga wo mu buseruko wari wazanye za nzige;
zitera igihugu cose ca Egiputa, zirundana ahantu hose mu gihugu ari nyinshi cane. Ntihari bwigere haba icago c’inzige kimeze nk’ico, nta n’ikizosubira kubaho.
Zarapfutse isi gushika aho yose yirabura. Zitikiza ivyari vyasigajwe n’urubura, uri imirima, ivyamwa, n’ibiti. Nta citwa icatsi, canke igiti, canke igiterwa cabaye kikirangwa mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Farawo aca atumako ningoga Mose na Aroni, ababwira ati: “Nacumuye k’ Uhoraho Imana yanyu no kuri mwebwe.
Nimusubire mumparire icaha canje, munsabire Uhoraho Imana yanyu ankureko iki cago c’urupfu.”
Mose aca ava imbere ya Farawo, asenga Uhoraho .
Uhoraho na we aca ahindukiza wa muyaga, uhuhuta n’inkomezi nyinshi uvuye mu burengero, ugenda ukubuye inzige zose uzisuka mu Kiyaga Gitukura.
Ariko Uhoraho akomantaza umutima wa Farawo, na we ntiyarekura abantu ngo bagende.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ramvura ukuboko kwawe ukurabishije mu kirere, umwijima w’umuzitanya uca utera Egiputa, umwijima ukomeye kugeza aho umuntu yowukabakaba akawumva.”
Nuko Mose aramvura ukuboko akurabishije kw’ijuru, umwijima w’umuzitanya uca utwikira igihugu cose ca Egiputa, umara imisi itatu.
Nta washobora kubona uwundi, kandi nta wava aho ari ngo aje ahandi muri iyo misi itatu. Ariko aho Abisirayeli baba hoho hari umuco nk’uko bisanzwe.
Maze Farawo atumako Mose aramubwira ati: “Genda musenge Uhoraho . Nimujane n’abagore n’abana banyu, ariko ibitungwa vyanyu bisigare ngaha.”
Ariko Mose aramwishura ati: “Twemerere dutware ibimazi vyo guturira mu gushikanira Uhoraho Imana yacu.

Tugenda tujanye n’ibitungwa vyacu vyose, nta na kimwe dusiga inyuma. Muri vyo ni ho tuzotoramwo ivyo gushikanira Uhoraho Imana yacu, kandi tudashitseyo ntituzomenya ivyo tuzokoresha mu gushikanira Uhoraho .”
Ariko Uhoraho akomantaza umutima wa Farawo, ntiyemera kubarekura.
Farawo akankamira Mose ati: “Mva imbere, sinzosubire kukubona imbere yanje! Nkazosubira kukubona nzokwica.”
Mose aramwishura ati: “Nibibe nk’uko ubivuze, sinzokwongera kugaruka imbere yawe.”
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ngira ntere Farawo n’igihugu ca Egiputa ikindi cago. Hanyuma y’ivyo, azoca abareka mugende muve hano, kandi niyabikora azobirukana burundu.
Bwira abantu bose, abagabo n’abagore, basabe ababanyi babo utugenegene ducuzwe mw’ifeza no mu nzahabu.”
Maze Uhoraho aha Abisirayeli kugira ikiganza ciza ku Banyegiputa, Farawo n’abatware n’abantu biwe bose babona Mose nk’uwuhambaye mu gihugu ca Egiputa.
Nuko Mose avuga ati: “ Uhoraho avuze ngo: ‘Mu gicugu ndaza guca muri Egiputa hose.
Abana b’abahungu b’imfura bose bazopfa, uherereye ku mfura ya Farawo ari ku ngoma, ugashika ku mfura z’abaguranokazi bari inyuma y’abandi, ndetse n’ibitungwa vyavutse ubwa mbere na vyo nyene.
Hazoba amarira menshi atari bwigere aba muri Egiputa, kandi ntayazosubira kubaho ameze nka yo.
Ariko mu Bisirayeli, hazoba hatekanye, nta n’imbwa izokuga. Ni ho muzomenya ko Uhoraho yashizeho itandukaniro hagati ya Egiputa na Isirayeli.
Abatware bawe bose bazoza imbere yanje banyunamire, bavuga bati nimugende mwe n’abantu banyu! Aho ni ho nzobona kugenda.’ ” Maze Mose ava imbere ya Farawo yuzuye uburake bwinshi.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Farawo ntazokwumvira, kugira ngo ibitangaza vyanje bigwire muri Egiputa.”
Mose na Aroni bakoreye ivyo bitangaza vyose imbere ya Farawo, ariko Uhoraho akomantaza umutima wa Farawo, ntiyareka Abisirayeli ngo bave mu gihugu ciwe.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni bari muri Egiputa ati:
“Uku kwezi kuzobabera ukwa mbere mu yandi mezi; kuzobabera ukwa mbere mu mezi y’umwaka wanyu.
Barira Abisirayeli ko ku musi ugira icumi w’uku kwezi umuntu wese azoronderera umuryango wiwe umwagazi w’intama canke w’impene, umuryango wose uzorondere umwagazi umwe.
Umuryango ubaye muto aho utomara umwagazi, bazowusangire n’ababanyi bawegereye, bitewe n’igitigiri c’abari muri uwo muryango. Mutegekanye imyagazi ikwiranye n’uko abantu bangana.
Umwagazi muzotegura uzobe ishuri imaze umwaka, kandi ube uwutagira agasembwa.
Muzowubungabunge gushika ku musi ugira cumi na kane, maze abagize umuryango bazowukerere izuba rirenze.
Hanyuma muzofate amaraso yawo, muyasige ku bishimaryango vyompi no hejuru y’umuryango vy’amazu muzowuriramwo.
Inyama zawo muzozirye iryo joro nyene zokeje, muzikoze imboga zirura, n’imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Ntimuzozirye mbisi canke zitetse, ahubwo muzozotse. Muzozirye zose: umutwe, ibinono n’izo mu nda.
Ntihazogire izo muraza. Nihagira izirara, mu gatondo muzoziturire.
Nguku uko muzozirya mumeze: muzozirye mukenyeye, mwambaye ibirato, mufise n’inkoni yo kwitwaza mu minwe. Muzozirye mwihuta. Iyo ni yo Pasika y’ Uhoraho .
Iryo joro nyene nzoca muri Egiputa, nice imfura zose, iz’abantu n’iz’ibikoko, nongere ncire urubanza imana zose za Egiputa. Ni jewe Uhoraho ndabivuze.
Amaraso azoba ikimenyetso ku nzu murimwo, kandi aho nzobona amaraso nzoharengana. Nta cago co gutikiza kizobakorako ninakubita Egiputa.
Uwo musi muzohore muwibuka. Uko urunganwe rwanyu ruzogenda rukurikirana, muzohore muwuhimbaza nk’umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho .

Muzomare imisi indwi murya imikate itarimwo umwambiro. Ku musi wa mbere, muzokure umwambiro wose mu mazu yanyu, nayo uwuzorya ikintu na kimwe kirimwo umwambiro muri iyo misi indwi azocibwe mu Bisirayeli.

Ku musi wa mbere muzogire ikoraniro ryera, irindi muzorigire ku musi ugira indwi. Kandi ico kiringo cose muzokimare ata kindi gikorwa mukora, kiretse gutegura ivyo kurya. Ico ni co mwemerewe gukora conyene.

Muzohimbaze umusi mukuru w’imikate itarimwo umwambiro kuko ari kuri uwo musi nzoba narabakuriyeko muri Egiputa. Muzowuhimbaze nk’icagezwe kizokwamaho ibihe vyose uko urunganwe rwanyu ruzogenda rukurikirana.
Mu kwezi kwa mbere, muzorye imikate itarimwo umwambiro muhereye mw’ijoro ryo ku musi ugira icumi na kane gushika ku musi ugira mirongo ibiri na rimwe.
Muri iyo misi indwi, ntihazogire umwambiro urangwa mu mazu yanyu. Kandi uwuzorya ikintu na kimwe kirimwo umwambiro azocibwe mu muryango w’Abisirayeli, yaba kavantara canke uwavutse ari Umwisirayeli.
Ntihaze hagire ikintu na kimwe kirimwo umwambiro murya. Aho muzoba muba hose, muzorye imikate itarimwo umwambiro.”
Maze Mose akoranya abakuru bose bo mu Bisirayeli arababwira ati: “Ihute mugende muronderere imiryango yanyu imyagazi y’intama, mubage umwagazi wa Pasika.
Mufate udushami twa ezobu, mudukoze mw’ibesani irimwo amaraso, muyasige ku bishimaryango hejuru no hirya no hino y’urwinjiriro. Ntihazogire uwusohoka hanze gushika bukeye.
Uhoraho niyaca mu gihugu ca Egiputa gutikiza Abanyegiputa hanyuma akabona amaraso ku bishimaryango azoca arengana, ntazokwemera ko umuranduzi yinjira mu nzu zanyu kubatikiza.
Ibi mubikurikize nk’icagezwe kizokwamaho kuri mwebwe no ku bana banyu.
Nimwashika mu gihugu Uhoraho azobaha nk’uko yakibasezeraniye, muzokwame mwibuka kugira uwo musi mukuru.
Abana banyu nibababaza bati: ‘Mbega uwu musi mu vy’ukuri usigura iki?’

Muzobabwire muti: ‘Ni ikimazi ca Pasika dushikanira Uhoraho , kuko yarenganye amazu y’Abisirayeli muri Egiputa, arengana ingo zacu, atikiza Abanyegiputa.’ ” Mose ahejeje kubabwira ivyo, baca barunama barasenga.
Nuko Abisirayeli babikora nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose na Aroni.

Ijoro rigeze hagati, Uhoraho atikiza imfura zose zo muri Egiputa, uhereye ku mfura ya Farawo yatwara Egiputa ugashitsa no ku mfura z’abagurano biwe bari mu mabohero. N’ibitungwa vyavutse ubwa mbere birapfa.
Farawo n’abatware biwe hamwe n’Abanyegiputa bikanguye mw’ijoro, haba induru n’amaborogo menshi muri Egiputa, kuko ata nzu n’imwe yasigaye itabuze umuntu.
Mw’ijoro, Farawo ahamagaza Mose na Aroni arababwira ati: “Nimugende! Nimumvire mu bantu mwe n’Abisirayeli! Nimugende musenge Uhoraho nk’uko mwabisavye.
Nimujane ibitungwa vyanyu nk’uko mwabisavye, mugende, kandi mugende munsabiye umugisha.”
Abanyegiputa binginga Abisirayeli ngo bihute bave muri ico gihugu, kuko biyumvira bati: “Batagiye vuba, twese turapfa!”
Nuko Abisirayeli bafata ibikandu bitarimwo umwambiro, babishira mu twato bacumbamwo, babitwara ku bitugu bitekeye mu mitamana.
Abisirayeli bagenza uko Mose yababwiye, basaba Abanyegiputa ibikoresho bikozwe mu nzahabu no mw’ifeza hamwe n’ivyambarwa.
Uhoraho atuma Abanyegiputa baraba ryiza Abisirayeli, babaha ivyo babasavye, gutyo baba baranyaze Abanyegiputa.
Abisirayeli bafata urugendo bava i Ramusesi baja i Sukoti. Bari abagabo bashika nk’ibihumbi amajana atandatu, abagore n’abana batarimwo.
Hari n’isinzi ry’abandi batari Abisirayeli bajanye na bo, kandi bari kumwe n’ibitungwa vyinshi cane.

Mu mitsima y’ibikandu bakuye muri Egiputa, baciye bakora imikate itarimwo umwambiro. Icatumye ivyo bikandu bitabamwo umwambiro n’uko bavuye muri Egiputa bihuta; nta mwanya baronse wo gutegura iyindi mpamba.
Igihe Abisirayeli bamaze muri Egiputa ni imyaka amajana ane na mirongo itatu.
Ku musi wa nyuma w’iyo myaka amajana ane na mirongo itatu ni ho ingabo z’ Uhoraho zava muri Egiputa.

Kubera yuko Uhoraho yabereye maso Abisirayeli iryo joro ryose kugira ngo abakure muri Egiputa, Abisirayeli na bo bategerezwa kwama barirarako bari maso, kugira ngo baheshe Imana icubahiro uko urunganwe rwabo ruzogenda rukurikirana.
Uhoraho abarira Mose na Aroni ati: “Ibi ni vyo muzokurikiza mu kurya ivya Pasika: Ntihaze hagire umunyamahanga azobiryako.
Ariko nihaba hari umugurano mwaguze, azobiryeko nimba yarakebwe.
Ariko uwuzoba abana namwe igihe gito canke umucangero ntaze abiryeko.
Umwagazi w’intama wa Pasika muzowurire mu nzu, ntihaze hagire inyama muzosohokana hanze, kandi ntihaze hagire igufa na rimwe muzovuna.
Imiryango ya Isirayeli yose izohimbaze umusi mukuru wa Pasika.

Abanyamahanga baba muri mwebwe bagomba guhimbaza Pasika y’ Uhoraho , abagabo bo muri bo bose bazobanze bakebwe, babone gusangira n’abavutse ari Abisirayeli. Ariko ntihaze hagire uwutakebwe arya ku vya Pasika.
Iri tegeko rigenga bose, baba abavutse ari Abisirayeli canke abanyamahanga bazoba baba muri mwebwe.”
Abisirayeli bose babigenza uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose na Aroni.
Uwo musi nyene, Uhoraho akura Abisirayeli muri Egiputa nk’uko imice y’ingabo zabo yari iri.

headings.text: Ivy’Isabato n’imisi mikuru y’imikate itarimwo umwambiro

verses.text: Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Muzonyegurire icavutse ubwa mbere cose mu Bisirayeli. Icavutse ubwa mbere cose kizoba icanje, ari mu bantu canke mu bitungwa.”

Maze Mose abarira abantu ati: “Muzokwame muhimbaza uwu musi, uwo Imana ibakuriyeko muri Egiputa, ikabakura mu gihugu c’ubuja, kuko Uhoraho abakujeyo ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi. Ntihaze hagire ikintu na kimwe murya kirimwo umwambiro.
Uwu musi, mu kwezi kwa Abibu, mugira mugende.

Uhoraho niyabashikana mu gihugu c’Abanyakanani, Abaheti, Abamori, Abahiwi n’Abayebusi, igihugu yarahiye ba sogokuruza ko azokibaha, igihugu gitemba amata n’ubuki, muzokwame muhimbaza uwu musi mukuru muri uku kwezi nyene ku mwaka ku mwaka.
Muzomare imisi indwi murya imikate itarimwo umwambiro, hanyuma ku musi ugira indwi muhimbaze umusi mukuru w’ Uhoraho .
Muzorye imikate itarimwo umwambiro muri iyo misi indwi, ntihaze hagire ikintu na kimwe kirimwo umwambiro kiba muri mwebwe, canke mu karere mubamwo.
Kuri uwo musi umuntu wese azobwire abana biwe ati: ‘Ibi ndabikora mu kwibuka ivyo Uhoraho yadukoreye igihe yadukura muri Egiputa.’
Uwo musi mukuru uzobabera nk’ikimenyetso co ku maboko, n’icibutso co mu ruhanga, kugira ngo Ivyagezwe vy’ Uhoraho vyame mu kanwa kanyu, kuko Uhoraho yabakuje muri Egiputa ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi.
Muzokwame mwibuka iki cagezwe c’uwu musi ibihe vyose uko umwaka uheze.
Uhoraho niyamara kubashikana mu gihugu c’Abanyakanani akakibaha nk’uko yakibasezeraniye, akagisezeranira na ba sogokuruza,
muzomwegurire imfura yose ivutse y’umuhungu. Kandi igitungwa cose kizovuka ubwa mbere ari ic’igitsina gabo ni ic’ Uhoraho .
Ibaye ari indogoba, mu gishingo cayo muze mushikane umwagazi w’intama. Bitabaye uko, muzoyivune izosi. Umwana w’umuhungu w’imfura na we nyene azocungurwe.
Mu bihe bizoza, abana banyu nibababaza bati: ‘Mbega ivyo none bisigura iki?’ Muzobishure muti: ‘ Uhoraho yadukuye mu buja mu gihugu ca Egiputa adukujeyo ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi.

Igihe Farawo yakomantaza umutima akatwankira kuvayo, Uhoraho yishe imfura z’abahungu zose z’Abanyegiputa, yica n’imfura zose z’ibitungwa. Ni co gituma dushikanira Uhoraho ikimazi c’ivy’imfura vyose vy’igitsina gabo, abahungu bacu b’imfura na bo tukabacunguza umwagazi w’intama.’
Uwo musi mukuru uzobabere nk’ikimenyetso ku maboko yanyu canke ikimeyetso ku ruhanga rwanyu, kizobibutsa ko Uhoraho yadukuje muri Egiputa ukuboko kwiwe kw’inkomezi.”

Igihe Farawo yarekura abantu ngo bagende, Imana ntiyabacishije mu nzira itumbereye mu gihugu c’Abafilisitiya, n’aho ari yo yari inzira ya hafi. Kubera yuko Imana yavuga iti: “Hamwe bohura n’intambara bohava bahindura ivyiyumviro, bagasubira muri Egiputa.”
Maze Imana ibazungurukisha mu nzira yo mu bugaragwa ahatumbereye ku Kiyaga Gitukura, kandi Abisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa biteguye kurya kw’ingabo zigiye ku rugamba.

Mose yagiye ajanye amagufa ya Yosefu kuko Abisirayeli bari bararahiye Yosefu ko bazoyajana. Yari yababwiye ati: “Ndazi neza ko Imana itazobura kubibuka. Niyabibuka muzogende mujanye amagufa yanje muyakure muri iki gihugu.”
Bavuye i Sukoti baciye bacumbika ahitwa Etamu ku mpera y’ubugaragwa.
Uhoraho yabaja imbere ku murango ari mu nkingi y’igicu, mw’ijoro na ho akabaja imbere ari mu nkingi y’umuriro kugira ngo abamurikire, bashobore kubandanya urugendo ku murango no mw’ijoro.
Iyo nkingi y’igicu ntiyigera iva imbere yabo ku murango, n’iyo nkingi y’umuriro ntiyabava imbere mw’ijoro.

headings.text: Ivyo gushikanira Uhoraho ibivutse ubwa mbere

verses.text: Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Barira Abisirayeli basubire inyuma, bacumbike ahitwa Pi Hahiroti, hagati ya Migidoli n’ikiyaga. Bacumbike i ruhande y’ikiyaga, aharabana na Bayali-Zefoni.
Farawo azokwibaza ati: ‘Abisirayeli bazimiye bariko barayerera, bazazaniwe, ubugaragwa bwabahindukiye nk’ibohero.’

Nanje nzokomantaza umutima wa Farawo kugira ngo abakurikire. Hanyuma nzohesha izina ryanje icubahiro nciye kuri Farawo n’ingabo ziwe, kandi Abanyegiputa bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho .” Maze Abisirayeli bacumbikaho nk’uko Uhoraho yabibabwiye.

Umwami wa Egiputa yumvise ko Abisirayeli bagiye, Farawo n’abatware biwe baca barisubirako bati: “Mbega ibi twakoze ni ibiki? Twararetse Abisirayeli baragenda none ibikorwa vyose bahora badukorera birabuze ababikora!”
Nuko Farawo ategura umukogote wiwe, akoranya n’ingabo ziwe.
Afata imikogote amajana atandatu ya mbere ikomeye, ajana n’imikogote yose yo muri Egiputa, umwumwe wose waba urimwo abasoda bakuru.
Uhoraho akomantaza umutima wa Farawo, umwami wa Egiputa, akurikira Abisirayeli, kandi abo Bisirayeli bari bavuye muri ico gihugu bagenda bashize amanga rwose.
Abanyegiputa bagizwe n’abagendera ku mafarasi no ku mikogote bose, bakurikira Abisirayeli, babasanga aho bacumbitse i ruhande y’ikiyaga, hafi ya Pi Hahiroti, aharabana na Bayali-Zefoni.
Farawo abegereje, Abisirayeli bunamura amaso babona Abanyegiputa babakurikiye, bagira ubwoba bwinshi, baririra Uhoraho .
Babarira Mose bati: “Mbega muri Egiputa nta mva zariyo aho warinda utuzana gupfira mu bugaragwa? Kubera iki wadukuye muri Egiputa?
Ntitwari twakubwiye tuti: ‘Tureke dukorere Abanyegiputa’? Twopfuma dukorera Abanyegiputa hako tuza gupfira mu bugaragwa.”
Mose arabishura ati: “Ntaco mutinya. Nimwihagararire gusa murabe agakiza Uhoraho agira abazanire uno musi. Aba Banyegiputa mubona uno musi, ntimuzosubira kubabona.
Uhoraho agira abagwanire mwebwe nimutekereze gusa.”
Maze Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ni iki gitumye untakambira? Barira Abisirayeli babandanye urugendo.
Nawe manika inkoni yawe uramvurire ukuboko kwawe hejuru y’ikiyaga, ugicemwo kabiri kugira ngo Abisirayeli babone kugicamwo nk’abagendera kw’isi yumutse.
Ngira nkomantaze imitima y’Abanyegiputa kugira ngo babakurikire. Ndihesha icubahiro kuri Farawo n’ingabo ziwe, ku mikogote yiwe no ku bagendera ku mafarasi biwe.
Abanyegiputa bazomenya ko ndi Uhoraho ninihesha icubahiro kuri Farawo n’ingabo ziwe, ku mikogote yiwe no ku bagendera ku mafarasi biwe.”
Maze umumarayika w’Imana yahora agendera imbere y’ingabo z’Abisirayeli, arahindukira aja inyuma yabo. Ya nkingi y’igicu na yo nyene iva imbere yabo, ibaja inyuma,
ija hagati y’ingabo z’Abanyegiputa n’Abisirayeli. Mw’ijoro, ku ruhande rumwe rw’ico gicu haba umwijima, ku rundi ruhande hakaba umuco; bituma Abanyegiputa bategerana n’Abisirayeli burinda buca.

Maze Mose aramvurira ukuboko hejuru ya ca kiyaga, Uhoraho aca ahuhutisha umuyaga uvuye mu buseruko usubiza ikiyaga inyuma, uca inzira. Uwo muyaga uhuhuta ijoro ryose gushika aho hasi mu kiyaga hasigara ari isi yumutse.
Abisirayeli baraheza baca mu kiyaga cari cigabuyemwo kabiri, bagendera kw’isi yumutse, amazi ameze nk’ibihome i buryo n’i bubamfu.
Abanyegiputa barabakurikira. Abagendera ku mafarasi n’abagendera mu mikogote ba Farawo bose barabakurikira no gushika mu kiyaga.
Ariko nko mu mutwenzi bugira buce, Uhoraho yihweza ingabo z’Abanyegiputa ari muri ya nkingi y’umuriro, maze azisukamwo umuvurungano,
atuma amapine y’imikogote afata hasi, vyanka ko bayikwega. Abanyegiputa baravugana bati: “Ehe nimuze tuve inyuma y’aba Bisirayeli. Uhoraho ari ku ruhande rwabo agwanya Abanyegiputa.”
Maze Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Ramvurira ukuboko kwawe hejuru y’ikiyaga kugira ngo amazi ateranire ku Banyegiputa n’imikogote yabo n’abagendera ku mafarasi.”
Nuko Mose aramvurira ukuboko kwiwe hejuru ya ca kiyaga, maze mu mutwenzi ikiyaga kiraterana, gisubira uko cahora. Abanyegiputa bagerageza guhunga, ariko Uhoraho abahonereza mu kiyaga.
Amazi araterana, arengera imikogote n’abagendera ku mafarasi, hamwe n’ingabo za Farawo zose zari zakurikiye Abisirayeli mu kiyaga. Nta n’umwe muri bo yarokotse.
Ariko Abisirayeli baciye mu kiyaga bagendera kw’isi yumutse, bahagatiwe n’impome z’amazi i buryo n’i bubamfu.
Uwo musi Uhoraho akiza Abisirayeli ukuboko kw’Abanyegiputa, Abisirayeli babona imivyimba y’Abanyegiputa yandagaye ku nkengera z’ikiyaga.
Abisirayeli babonye ukuboko kw’inkomezi Imana yerekanye mu kugwanya Abanyegiputa, bahindira agashitsi imbere y’ Uhoraho , baramwizera, bizera na Mose umusavyi wiwe.
Maze Mose n’Abisirayeli baririmbira Uhoraho indirimbo bati: “Ndaririmbira Uhoraho , kuko ashizwe hejuru cane. Ifarasi n’uwuyigenderako yabisutse mu kiyaga.
Uhoraho ni we nkomezi zanje n’indirimbo yanje, yambereye agakiza. Ni we Mana yanje, nanje nzomuhimbaza. Ni yo Mana ya ba sogokuruza, nanje nzoyishira hejuru.
Uhoraho ni ingabo mu ntambara, Uhoraho ni ryo zina ryiwe.
Imikogote ya Farawo hamwe n’ingabo ziwe yabisutse mu kiyaga. Abagabisha b’ingabo bahambaye ba Farawo batwawe n’Ikiyaga Gitukura.
Amazi y’ibenga yarabarengeye, bibiye nk’ikibuye giterewe mw’iriba.
Uhoraho we, ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo ni ukw’icubahiro n’ububasha. Ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo kwatikije abansi.
Mu butware bwawe buhambaye watembagaje abitambitse imbere yawe. Warekuye uburake bwawe bw’inkazi bubatongora nk’umuriro utongora ivyatsi.
Impwemu zo mu mazuru yawe zatumye amazi yiyegeranya, amazi y’imikuba ahagarara nk’igihome, amazi yo mu nda y’ikiyaga akomera nk’urutare.
Umwansi yigamba ati: ‘Ndabakurikira kandi ndabafata. Ndabambura ivyabo, nongere ndabimarireko ishavu. Ndasokorora inkota yanje, ukuboko kwanje kubarandure.’
Ariko wahumetse impwemu zawe ikiyaga kirabarengera. Basomye nturi nk’icuma giterewe mw’ibenga.
Mbega ni iyihe Mana yindi ihwanye nawe, ewe Uhoraho ? Ni nde asa nawe? Uri uwera, ubwiza bwawe buratangaje. Uri uwera cane, ukora ibitangaza.
Waramvuye ukuboko kwawe kw’i buryo isi irasama imira abansi bacu.
Mu rukundo rwawe rudahera warongoye abo wacunguye. Mu nkomezi zawe wabashikanye ahera hawe.
Amahanga yaravyumvise arajugumira, Abafilisitiya bicwa n’umubabaro.
Abatware ba Edomu bishwe n’ubwoba, abarongozi ba Mowabu bahinda agashitsi, nayo Abanyakanani bacika intege;
bazofatwa n’ubwoba batinye. Ububasha bw’ukuboko kwawe buzotuma bajunja nk’ibuye, gushika abantu bawe barenganye, ewe Uhoraho ; gushika abantu wiguriye barenganye.
Uzobashikanayo, ubashimangire ku musozi w’umugabane wawe, ikibanza witunganirije ngo abe ari ho uba, ewe Uhoraho , Ahera wishiriyeho, ewe Mana.
Uhoraho araganje ibihe vyose!”
Igihe amafarasi ya Farawo, imikogote yiwe n’abagendera ku mafarasi bibira mu kiyaga, Uhoraho yabateranirijeko ikiyaga, ariko Abisirayeli bagiciyemwo bagendera kw’isi yumutse.
Maze uwuvugishwa n’Imana Miriyamu, mushiki wa Aroni, afata ingoma arayivuza, abandi bagore bagenziwe bose na bo bifatanya na we, bafata ingoma zabo, bashirako baratamba.
Miriyamu aririmba avuga ati: “Muririmbire Uhoraho , kuko ashizwe hejuru cane. Ifarasi n’uwayigenderako yabitereye mu kiyaga.”
Maze Mose arongora Abisirayeli bava ku Kiyaga Gitukura baja mu bugaragwa bw’i Shuri. Bamara imisi itatu bagenda mu bugaragwa babura amazi.
Bashitse i Mara, ntibashobora kunywa amazi yaho kuko yarura. Ni co gituma bahita Mara, bisigura ngo “Umururazi”.
Maze abantu bidodombera Mose, bavuga bati: “Mbega tunywa iki?”
Maze Mose atakambira Uhoraho , na we amwereka agashami k’igiti. Agaterera mu mazi, ayo mazi aca ahinduka ayanyobwa. Aho i Mara ni ho Imana yabahereye amabwirizwa n’amategeko, yongera irabasuzuma,

ibabwira iti: “Nimwatega ugutwi ivyo jewe Uhoraho Imana yanyu ndababwira, mugakora ibiroranye mu nyonga zanje, mugakurikiza amabwirizwa n’amategeko yanje, sinzobatera ingwara nk’izo nateye Abanyegiputa, kuko ndi Uhoraho abakiza ingwara.”
Nuko bashika ahitwa Elimu, ahari amariba icumi n’abiri hamwe n’ibigazi mirongo indwi, baca bacumbika aho hafi y’ayo mazi.
Abisirayeli bose bava ahitwa Elimu bashika mu bugaragwa b’i Sini, buri hagati ya Elimu na Sinayi, hari ku musi ugira icumi na gatanu wo mu kwezi kugira kabiri kuva bavuye muri Egiputa.
Muri ubwo bugaragwa, bidodombera Mose na Aroni.

Abisirayeli babawira bati: “Iyo Uhoraho apfuma atwiyicira we nyene tukiri muri Egiputa! Hariya ho twaricara ku nkono z’inyama, tukarya n’imikate tugahimba. Ariko raba mwatuzanye muri ubu bugaragwa kutwicisha inzara.”

Uhoraho aca abarira Mose ati: “Ngiye kubakororera imikate iva mw’ijuru. Abantu bose bazohore bazinduka mu gatondo, batore iyo bakeneye ku musi gusa. Iki ni co nzobageragerezako kugira ngo ndabe ko bazokurikiza ivyo ndabategetse.
Ku musi ugira gatandatu, baze begeranye incuro zibiri iyo bahora begeranya ku yindi misi.”
Nuko Mose na Aroni baca babwira Abisirayeli bati: “Muri iri joro muraja kumenya ko Uhoraho ari we yabakuye muri Egiputa,
kandi ejo mu gatondo muzobona ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho , kuko yumvise ingene mwamwidodombeye. Mbega twebwe twakoze iki aho mutwidodombera?”

Mose yongera arababwira ati: “ Uhoraho agiye kubaha inyama muzorya mw’ijoro n’imikate izobahaza mu gatondo, kuko yumvise ingene mwamwidodombeye. Mbega twebwe turi iki? Si twebwe mwidodombeye, ahubwo mwidodombeye Uhoraho .”
Maze Mose abarira Aroni ati: “Barira imiryango yose y’Abisirayeli uti: ‘Nimuze imbere y’ Uhoraho , kuko yumvise ukwidodomba kwanyu.’ ”
Aroni akiriko aravugana n’imiryango yose ya Isirayeli, batereza amaso mu bugaragwa, babona ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho bugaragariye mu bicu.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati:
“Numvise ukwidodomba kw’Abisirayeli. Babwire uti: ‘Ku mugoroba w’ijoro, muraja kurya inyama, ejo mu gitondo na ho muzorya imikate muhage. Ni ho muzomenya ko ndi Uhoraho Imana yanyu.’ ”
Kuri uwo mugoroba haza inkware, zuzura aho bacumbitse hose. Mu gatondo na ho haza urume rwinshi rukikuza aho bari bacumbitse.
Rwa rume ruheze, hasigara utuntu tumeze nk’utuvunguka tw’imikate twinshi kandi twuzuye hasi.
Abisirayeli babibonye barabazanya bati: “Mbega ibi ni ibiki?” Kuko batigeze bamenya ivyo ari vyo. Mose arababwira ati: “Uwo ni umukate Uhoraho yabahaye ngo murye.”
Uhoraho yategetse ati: “Umuntu wese yegeranye ibimuhagije, ajane ingero omeru zikwiye ababa mw’ihema ryiwe.”
Abisirayeli babikora uko babibwiwe, bamwe begeranya vyinshi, abandi bike.

Bamaze kubigera ku ngero yitwa omeru, abegeranije vyinshi basanga ntibirenze na gato ivyo bakeneye, abegeranije bike na bo nyene basanga ntaco bakeheje ku vyo bari bakeneye. Umuntu wese yegeranije, yasanga afise ibihwanye n’ivyo yari akeneye.
Mose arababwira ati: “Ntihaze hagire uwubiraza gushika mu gatondo.”
Yamara hari abatumviye Mose, barabiraza gushika mu gitondo, ariko basanga vyamaze kuzamwo inyo, binuka nabi. Maze Mose arabarakira.
Imisi yose mu gatondo, umuntu wese yategerezwa kwegeranya iyo akeneye yose, kuko izuba rimaze gukara yaca ishonga.
Ku musi ugira gatandatu begeranya nk’iyo bahora begeranya incuro zibiri, ni ukuvuga ingero omeru zibiri ku muntu, maze abakuru barongoye abandi baraza babibarira Mose.
Na we arababarira ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho yategetse: ‘Ejo uzobe umusi w’akaruhuko, Isabato yera y’ Uhoraho . Genda mutegure ivyokurya mukeneye, ibisigara mubiraze bibe ivy’ejo.’ ”
Maze barabiraza gushika mu gatondo nk’uko Mose yari yabibategetse, kandi ntivyigeze bibora canke ngo binuke.
Mose arababwira ati: “Ivyo mubirye uno musi, kuko ari Isabato y’ Uhoraho . Uno musi nta bindi muza gusanga vyandagaye hasi.
Muzomara imisi itandatu muvyegeranya, ariko ku musi w’indwi ari wo w’Isabato ntibizoza.”
Ariko, hariho abagiye kuvyegeranya ku musi w’indwi, mugabo ntibagira ico bahasanga.
Maze Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Mbega abo bantu bazogeza ryari kutumvira amabwirizwa yanje n’ivyo ndabihanikiriza?

Bategerezwa gutahura ko Uhoraho yabahaye Isabato nk’ingabire. Ni co gituma ku musi wa gatandatu yabahaye ivyokurya vy’imisi ibiri. Umwe wese azogume iwe ku musi ugira indwi, ntihazogire uwuja hanze kurondera ivyokurya.”
Nuko abantu bose bararuhuka nta wongeye kuja kwegeranya ivyokurya ku musi ugira indwi.
Abisirayeli bita uwo mukate manu. Uwo mukate wera nk’utubuto tw’igiterwa citwa koriyanderi ugasosa nk’uwurimwo ubuki.
Mose aravuga ati: “Uku ni ko Uhoraho ategetse: ‘Mufate ingero omeru imwe ya manu, muyibike kugira ngo n’abuzukuruza banyu bazobone umukate nabahereye mu bugaragwa igihe nabakura muri Egiputa.’ ”
Maze Mose abarira Aroni ati: “Fata agakono, ugashiremwo ingero omeru imwe ya manu. Ugatware ugashire imbere y’ Uhoraho , ukabikire urunganwe ruzoza.”
Nuko Aroni abikora nk’uko Uhoraho yabitegetse Mose, abika ya manu mw’Isandugu y’Isezerano, i ruhande ya vya bisate vy’amabuye vyanditseko amabwirizwa.
Abisirayeli bamaze imyaka mirongo ine barya manu kugeza bashitse mu gihugu bari bagiye kubamwo. Bariye manu gushika bashitse ku rubibe rw’i Kanani.
Ingero bakoresha mu kugera manu yitwa omeru, yari ic’icumi c’ingero yitwa efa.

Ishengero ryose ry’Abisirayeli riva mu bugaragwa bw’i Sini, bagenda barayerera, bava hamwe baja ahandi nk’uko Uhoraho yaba abibategetse. Maze bacumbika i Refidimu, ariko aho hantu nta mazi yariho yo kunywa.
Nuko batatira Mose bavuga bati: “Duhe amazi yo kunywa!” Mose arabishura ati: “Ni kuki muntatira? Ni iki gitumye mugerageza Uhoraho ?”
Ariko kubera inyota nyinshi, bakomeza kwidodombera Mose bati: “Ni kuki mwatuduganye mudukuye muri Egiputa mukatuzana kutwicisha inyota twe n’abana bacu n’ibitungwa vyacu?”
Maze Mose abarira Uhoraho ati: “Mbega aba bantu ndabagire gute? Hasigaye gatoya bakantera amabuye.”
Uhoraho yishura Mose ati: “Ca imbere y’abantu ugende. Uhitane bamwe mu bakuru barongoye abandi mu Bisirayeli, ujane na ya nkoni wakubitisha uruzi Nili, muheze mugende.
Ndahagarara imbere yanyu ku gitandara c’i Horebu. Nawe uheze ukubite ico gitandara, gica kivamwo amazi, abantu banywe.” Maze Mose abikora gutyo mu maso y’abakuru barongoye abandi mu Bisirayeli.
Aho hantu aca ahita Masa na Meriba, kuko Abisirayeli bahatonganiye bakongera bakahageragereza Uhoraho bavuga bati: “Mbega Uhoraho ari kumwe natwe canke ntari kumwe natwe?”
Abisirayeli bakiri i Refidimu, ingabo z’Abamaleki ziraza zirabatera.
Mose abarira Yosuwa ati: “Toranya abagabo bashobora kuja kugwanya Abamaleki. Ejo nzohagarara hejuru ku gatwe k’umusozi nitwaje ya nkoni y’Imana mu minwe.”
Nuko Yosuwa agwanya Abamaleki nk’uko Mose yabimubwiye, ariko Mose, Aroni na Huri bobo baduga ku gatwe k’uwo musozi.
Umwanya wose Mose yamara adugije ya nkoni yari afise mu minwe, Abisirayeli baranesha. Ariko arushe akayimanura, Abamaleki baca babanesha.

Amaboko ya Mose amaze kuruha atagishobora kuguma ayagoroye, Aroni na Huri baca bazana ibuye Mose aryicarako, maze bamugumiriza amaboko hejuru, umwe ku ruhande rumwe uwundi ku rundi, kugira ngo amaboko yiwe agume yemye gushika izuba rirenze.
Maze Yosuwa anesha ingabo z’Abamaleki, abamarisha inkota.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Niwandike ibi mu gitabu, kugira ngo bize vyame vyibukwa, kandi ubimenyeshe na Yosuwa, kuko nzorandura Abamaleki ntibazosubire kwibukwa musi y’ijuru.”
Mose aca yubaka igicaniro acita Yehova Nisi, bisigura ngo “ Uhoraho ni we bendera ryanje”.
Aca avuga ati: “Badugirije amaboko yabo kugwanya Uhoraho , none rero Uhoraho azokwama agwanya Abamaleki uko urunganwe ruzogenda rukurikira urundi.”
Maze Yetiro, umuherezi w’i Midiyani akaba na sebukwe wa Mose, yumva ivyo Imana yakoreye Mose n’Abisirayeli, n’ukuntu Uhoraho yakuye Abisirayeli muri Egiputa.
Imbere y’aho Mose yari yararungitse iwabo umugore wiwe Zipora hamwe n’abahungu biwe babiri, sebukwe Yetiro arabakira.
Umuhungu wa mbere wa Mose yamwise Gerishomu risigura inyambukira, kuko Mose yavuga ati: “Nabaye inyambukira mu mahanga.”
Uwa kabiri yamwise Eliyezeri, risigura ngo Uhoraho ni we mutabazi wanje, kuko Mose yavuga ati: “Imana ya ba sogokuruza yambereye umufasha, yankijije inkota ya Farawo.”
Yetiro, sebukwe wa Mose, ari kumwe n’abahungu ba Mose na muka Mose, baza mu bugaragwa aho Mose yari acumbitse hafi y’umusozi w’Imana.
Yetiro yari yatumye intumwa kuri Mose ati: “Jewe sobukwe Yetiro ndaje kukuraba ndi kumwe n’umugore wawe n’abahungu biwe babiri.”
Maze Mose aja gusanganira sebukwe, aramwunamira, aramugumbira. Bahejeje kuramukanya, baca binjirana mw’ihema.
Mose yiganira sebukwe ivyo Uhoraho yakoreye Farawo n’Abanyegiputa kubw’Abisirayeli, amwiganira n’amakuba baciyemwo mu nzira yose n’ingene Uhoraho yayabakijije.
Maze Yetiro aranezerwa cane yumvise ivyiza Uhoraho yakoreye Abisirayeli akabakiza Abanyegiputa.
Aravuga ati: “ Uhoraho nahimbazwe, we yabakijije Abanyegiputa na Farawo, agakura Abisirayeli mu maboko y’Abanyegiputa.
Ubu rero menye ko Uhoraho asumba izindi mana zose, kuko yavyerekanye igihe yatabara ubwoko bwiwe akabukura mu gacinyizo k’Abanyegiputa.”
Maze Yetiro, sebukwe wa Mose, aca ashikanira Uhoraho imibavu n’ibindi bimazi, Aroni na we aca azanana n’abatware bose b’Abisirayeli, basangira ivyokurya na sebukwe wa Mose bari imbere y’Imana.
Bukeye mu gatondo, Mose afata icicaro ngo ace imanza, maze abantu baramukikuza ririnda rirenga.
Sebukwe abonye ivyo Mose akorera abantu vyose, aramubaza ati: “Mbega ivyo uriko urakora ni ibiki? Kubera iki uca imanza wenyene, abantu bakagukikuza rikarinda rirenga?”
Mose aramwishura ati: “Ni kubera abantu baza aho ndi barondera kumenya ico Imana ishaka.
Iyo hagize uwugira ico apfa n’uwundi, baraza aho ndi nkabacira imanza, nkabereka ivyo amategeko n’ivyagezwe vy’Imana bivuga.”
Sebukwe wa Mose aramubwira ati: “Ivyo uriko urakora si vyiza.
Wewe mwe n’abo bantu bose muzoruha kuko igikorwa ufise ari kinini. Ntushobora kugikora neza wenyene.
Ntega amatwi ndaguhe impanuro, kandi Imana ibane nawe. Ubandanye userukira abantu ku Mana, uyizanira amatati yabo.
Ubigishe amategeko n’ivyagezwe, kandi ubereke uko bakwiye kwigenza n’ivyo bakwiye gukora.
Ariko utoranye bamwe mu bantu bubaha Imana, b’abizigirwa, banka igiturire, ubagire abacamanza bamwe b’ibihumbi, abandi b’amajana, abandi ba mirongo itanu hamwe n’aba cumi.
Ubagire abacamanza b’abandi ibihe vyose, bazohore bakuzanira imanza zigoye gusa, izoroshe abe ari bo bazica. Ivyo bizotuma igikorwa cawe coroha kuko bazokigufasha.
Niwabikora uko, kandi nimba bivuye ku Mana, ntuzoruha cane kandi n’abantu bazotunganirizwa.”
Nuko Mose yumvira sebukwe, abikora uko yabimubwiye.
Atoranya abantu mu Bisirayeli bose bashoboye guca imanza, abagira abarongozi bazocira imanza abandi, bamwe ibihumbi, abandi amajana, abandi mirongo itanitanu, abandi na bo cumicumi.
Abo bantu bamara imyanya yabo yose bacira imanza abantu. Izigoye bagaca bazizanira Mose, ariko izoroshe bakazica bonyene.
Maze Mose asezera sebukwe, sebukwe aca asubira mu gihugu ciwe.
Mu kwezi kugira gatatu Abisirayeli bavuye muri Egiputa, ku musi wakwo wa mbere, ni ho bashika mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi.
Bavuye i Refidimu, binjiye mu bugaragwa bw’i Sinayi, bacumbika imbere y’umusozi Sinayi.
Maze Mose aduga ku musozi w’Imana kubonana na yo, Uhoraho aramuhamagara ari ku musozi, amubwira ati: “Ng’ibi ivyo uzobwira umuryango wa Yakobo, ivyo uzomenyesha ubwoko bwa Isirayeli, uti:
‘Mwarabonye ivyo nakoreye Egiputa, n’ingene nabagurukanye ku mababa y’inkukuma ndabazana aho ndi.
None rero nimwanyumvira mukaguma mw’isezerano ryanje, muzombera itunga rihambaye mu yandi mahanga yose, kuko isi yose ari iyanje.
Muzombera ihanga ry’abaherezi, ihanga ryejejwe.’ Uko abe ari ko uzobwira Abisirayeli.”
Maze Mose asubira inyuma, akoranya abakuru barongoye Abisirayeli ababwira ivyo Uhoraho yamutegetse kubabwira vyose.
Abantu bose bishurira rimwe bati: “Ivyo Uhoraho yategetse tuzobikurikiza vyose.” Nuko Mose na we aca asubira kubarira Uhoraho uko abantu bamubwiye.
Maze Uhoraho abwira Mose ati: “Nzobagendera ndi mu gicu kinini, kugira ngo abantu baze biyumvire uko mvugana nawe, maze bitume bakwizigira.” Nuko Mose abwira Uhoraho uko abantu bavuze.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Genda ubwire abantu bitegurire kunsaganira, biyeze uwu musi n’ejo, bamesure impuzu zabo.
Ku musi ugira gatatu bazobe biteguye kuko kuri uwo musi Uhoraho azomanuka ku musozi Sinayi abantu bamubona.

Nawe uzobashingire akarimbi ku musozi, uwukikuze, maze ugabishe abantu uti: Mwirinde ntihaze hagire uwuduga ku musozi, mbere ntihaze hagire n’uwegera akarimbi. Umuntu wese azokwegera uwo musozi nta nkeka azokwicwa.

Azokwicishwa amabuye canke araswe imyampi, nta kuboko kuzomukorako. Yaba umuntu canke igikoko ntikizobure kwicwa. Ariko inzamba y’ihembe ry’impfizi y’intama niyavuzwa ijwi rirerire, abantu bose ni ho bazoshobora kwegera uwo musozi.”
Mose amaze kumanuka akava kuri uwo musozi, abwira abantu bariyeza, bamesura impuzu zabo.
Arababwira ati: “Mwitegurire umusi ugira gatatu, kandi kugera uwo musi ntihaze hagire uwurangura amabanga mpuzabitsina.”
Mu gatondo k’umusi ugira gatatu, humvikana imituragaro, imiravyo irarabagiza, haza igicu kinini gipfuka wa musozi, havuga n’inzamba y’ijwi rirenga. Umuntu wese mu bari aho bacumbitse aterwa n’ubwoba.
Maze Mose aja imbere Abisirayeli, bava aho bari bacumbitse, baja kubonana n’Imana.
Umusozi Sinayi wuzura umwotsi, kuko Uhoraho yari yamanutse mu muriro. Uwo mwotsi upfunduka nk’uwuva mw’itanure, umusozi wose uratigita cane.
Rya jwi ry’inzamba rikomeza kwumvikana cane. Mose akavuga, Imana ikamwishura mw’ijwi ry’umuturagaro.
Uhoraho aramanuka ku musozi Sinayi, ahamagara Mose ngo aduge kw’itaba ry’uwo musozi, Mose na we araduga.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Genda wihanize abantu ntibahirahire ngo barengane ka karimbi ngo baduge kuraba Uhoraho , kuko benshi muri bo bopfa.
Mbere n’abaherezi bahora baza aho ndi babanze biyeze, kugira ngo jewe Uhoraho sindabarandure.”
Mose abarira Uhoraho ati: “Abantu ntibashobora kuduga ku musozi Sinayi, kuko wewe nyene watwihanije uti: ‘Kikuza umusozi n’akarimbi kugira ngo uhatoranye nk’ahera.’ ”
Uhoraho aramwishura ati: “Manuka udugane Aroni. Ariko abaherezi n’abandi bantu bose ntibarengane akarimbi ngo baze aho Uhoraho ari, kuko nohava ndabarandura.”
Nuko Mose abarira abantu ivyo Uhoraho yamubwiye vyose.
Maze Imana ivuga aya majambo yose iti:
“Ndi Uhoraho Imana yawe, yagukuye muri Egiputa, igihugu wabayemwo uri umugurano.
Ntukagire izindi mana umbangikanya.
Ntukibazire ikigirwamana mw’ishusho y’ikintu na kimwe, caba ico hejuru mw’ijuru canke hasi kw’isi, canke i kuzimu, canke mu biyaga.
Ntuzovyikubite imbere canke ngo ubikorere, kuko jewe Uhoraho Imana yawe ndi Imana ipfuha, mpanira abana ivyaha vya ba sekuruza babo gushika ku runganwe rwa gatatu n’urwa kane rw’abanyanka.
Ariko abankunda bakitondera ivyagezwe vyanje, ndabereka urukundo gushika ku runganwe rw’igihumbi.
Ntukavuge izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yawe ku busabusa. Kuko Uhoraho atazobura guhana abakoresha izina ryiwe ukutariko.
Wibuke guhimbaza umusi w’Isabato mu kuweza.
Uze ukore ibikorwa vyawe vyose mu misi itandatu,

ariko umusi w’indwi ni Isabato y’ Uhoraho Imana yawe. Kuri uwo musi, yaba wewe, umuhungu canke umukobwa wawe, yaba umukozi wawe w’umuhungu canke w’umukobwa, ibitungwa vyawe canke umunyamahanga aba iwawe, ntihaze hagire igikorwa na kimwe muwukorako.
Kuko mu misi itandatu ari ho Uhoraho yaremye ijuru, isi n’ikiyaga, n’ibiri muri vyo vyose, hanyuma akaruhuka ku musi ugira indwi. Ni co gituma Uhoraho yahezagiye Isabato akayigira iyera.
Wubahe so na nyoko kugira ngo uzorambire mu gihugu Uhoraho Imana yawe iguhaye.
Ntukice.
Ntugasambane.
Ntukibe.
Ntukarementanirize ibinyoma mugenzawe.
Ntukipfuze inzu ya mugenzawe canke umugore wa mugenzawe, umukozi wiwe w’umuhungu canke w’umukobwa, inka yiwe canke indogoba, canke ikindi kintu cose ca mugenzawe.”
Abantu babonye imiravyo bakumva n’imituragaro n’ijwi ry’inzamba, bakabona n’umusozi wuzuye umwotsi, barajugumira baterwa n’ubwoba bwinshi, baguma bahagaze kure.
Babarira Mose bati: “Twibwirire wewe nyene turakwumvira. Ntureke Imana ngo ibe ari yo itwibwirira, twohava dupfa.”
Mose abarira abantu ati: “Ntimugire ubwoba. Imana yaje kubagerageza kugira ngo igitinyiro cayo kigume muri mwebwe, gitume mudakora ivyaha.”
Maze abantu baguma bahagaze kure, Mose aba ari we wenyene yegera ico gicu kinini c’umuzitanya Imana yarimwo.
Uhoraho abarira Mose ati: “Barira Abisirayeli uti: ‘Mwiboneye ko navuganye namwe ndi mw’ijuru.
Ntihaze hagire izindi mana mumbangikanya. Ntimukicurire ibigirwamana mu nzahabu canke mw’ifeza.

Muze munyubakire igicaniro mukoresheje ivu, munshikanireko ibimazi vyanyu biturirwa n’umuriro, n’amashikanwa y’ishimwe, intama n’impene hamwe n’inka zanyu. Aho nzotuma mwibukira izina ryanje, nzohabasanga ndabahezagire.
Ariko, nimwacubaka mu mabuye, ntimuzokoreshe amabuye abajwe kuko murikojejeko icuma muba murihumanije.
Kandi ntihazogire uwuduga ku gicaniro nk’aho umuntu yoba agendera ku ngazi, kugira ngo ntacerekanireko ubwambure bwiwe.’
Ibi ni vyo vyagezwe uzobaha.
Niwagura umugurano w’Umuheburayo, azogukorere imyaka itandatu. Ku mwaka ugira indwi uze umureke yidegemvye, ata kiguzi atanze.
Niyaba yaje wenyene, azosubire inyuma wenyene. Ariko niyaba yazananye n’umugore, bazosubirane inyuma.
Shebuja niyamuha umugore, hanyuma akamuvyarako abahungu n’abakobwa, uwo mugore n’abana bazogume ari aba shebuja, umugabo wenyene ni we azokwidegemvya.
Ariko niyavuga ati: ‘Jewe ndakunda databuja n’umugore wanje n’abana banje, singomba kwidegemvya,’
shebuja akwiye kumuzana imbere y’Imana. Hanyuma, yongere amujane amuhagarike imbere y’igishimaryango, afate icuma amutobore ugutwi. Aho rero azoba abaye umugurano wiwe ubuzima bwiwe bwose.
Umuntu niyagurisha umukobwa wiwe nk’umuguranokazi, imyaka itandatu iheze, ntazokwidegemvya nk’uko bigenda ku bahungu.
Natahimbara shebuja yari yaramuguze, azomureke acungurwe. Ariko shebuja nta bubasha afise bwo kumugurisha ku banyamahanga, kuko ni we yahisemwo ko bavana.
Ariko, nimba shebuja ashimye ko yomushingira umuhungu wiwe, ico gihe azomushingirane iteka nk’umukobwa wiwe bwite.
Hamwe uwo mugabo yogomba kurongora uwundi mugore, ntihaze hagire ikintu na kimwe agabanya ku vyo yahora aha uwo wa mbere, haba ku mfungurwa, ku vyambarwa, canke ku mabanga y’abubatse.
Natamuha ivyo vyose uko ari bitatu, azoce yidegemvya ata kiguzi co kwicungura atanze.
Nihagira uwukubita uwundi akamwica, na we azokwicwe.
Ariko niyamwica atabishaka, ari kubera Imana yabiretse bikaba, azohungire mu gisagara nzomwereka.
Ariko uwuzokwica umuntu yabiteguye, muzomukure ku gicaniro canje mumwice.
Nihagira uwukubita se canke nyina azokwicwe.
Nihagira uwiba umuntu, akamugurisha canke akamufatanwa, azokwicwe.
Uwuzotuka se canke nyina azokwicwe.
Abantu babiri nibatongana, umwe agatera ibuye uwundi canke akamukubita ingumu ariko ntapfe, yamara bigatuma ategerezwa kwama aryamye ku buriri,

uwabikoze ntihaze hagire ico bamugira uwo muntu niyatora mitende agashobora kugendagenda yishimikije inkoni. Ariko ategerezwa kuzomushumbusha ivyo yatakaje igihe cose yamaze aryamye, kandi azogume amufasha gushika akire neza.
Umuntu niyakubita inkoni umugurano wiwe yaba umuhungu canke umukobwa, bikandurukamwo gupfa, azobihanirwe.
Ariko uwo mugurano niyakira inyuma y’umusi umwe canke ibiri, shebuja ntazobihanirwe kuko uwo mugurano yamuguze amahera yiwe.

Abantu babiri nibaba bariko baragwana, hanyuma bagaca ku mugore afise inda batabibonye, ya nda ikavuka hataragera, ariko ntihagire ikindi aba, uwamuciyeko azotange ico umugabo w’uwo mugore azosaba cose mu gihe kizoba cemejwe n’abacamanza.
Ariko uwo mugore niyagira ikindi aba, ubugingo buzohorwe ubundi,
ijisho rihorwe irindi, iryinyo rihorwe irindi, ukuboko guhorwe ukundi, ukuguru guhorwe ukundi,
ubushe buhorwe ubundi, igikomere gihorwe ikindi, umumyore uhorwe uwundi.
Umuntu niyakubita umugurano wiwe, yaba umuhungu canke umukobwa akamumena ijisho, azoce amureka yidegemvye, maze ico kizomubere inshumbusho ku jisho ryiwe.
Naho niyamukubita akamukuramwo iryinyo, na ho nyene azomureke yidegemvye, kimubere inshumbusho ku ryinyo ryiwe.
Impfizi niyaseka umuntu agapfa, na yo izokwicishwe amabuye, kandi inyama zayo ntizizoribwe. Ariko nyeneyo ntazobihanirwe.
Ariko nimba iyo mpfizi yari isanzwe yica, nyeneyo akaba yari yaramaze kuburirwa ariko ntayizirike hanyuma ikica umuntu, iyo mpfizi izokwicishwe amabuye kandi na nyeneyo azokwicwe.
Ariko bene uwo yishwe n’iyo mpfizi bemeye kwakira indishi y’akababaro, nyeneyo azocungure ubugingo bwiwe mu gutanga ivyo azosabwa vyose.
Iki cagezwe kizokurikizwe n’igihe impfizi izoba isetse umwana.
Impfizi niyaseka umugurano, nyeneyo azorihe shekeli mirongo itatu z’ifeza, azihe shebuja w’uwo mugurano, iyo mpfizi na yo izoterwe amabuye.
Umuntu niyimba ikinogo canke agapfukura ikinogo cari gipfutswe hanyuma ntagipfuke, maze inka canke indogoba ikakigwamwo,
nyene kucimba azorihe ico gitungwa, atware n’ico gitungwa capfuye.
Nihagira impfizi ikomeretsa iyindi ikayica, iyo yishe iyindi izogurishwe, ba nyenezo bagabure ayo mahera hamwe n’inyama z’iyapfuye.
Ariko nimba vyari bizwi ko iyo mpfizi ikunda kugwana, hanyuma nyeneyo ntaheze ngo yame ayiziritse, nyeneyo azorihe iyo yapfuye, hanyuma atware uwo muvyimba.
Nihagira uwiba inka canke intama, akayibaga canke akayigurisha, azorihe inka zitanu zo gushumbusha nyene iyo nka, n’intama zitanu zo gushumbusha nyene iyo ntama.
Umusuma niyicwa ariko aramena inzu y’umuntu, uwumwishe ntazoharurweko amaraso yiwe.

Ariko bibaye izuba ryamaze guseruka, uwuzomwica azoharurweko amaraso yiwe. Umusuma wese azofatwa azosubize ivyo yivye vyose, niyaba ata co afise co kubiriha, azogurishwe kugira ngo ivyo yivye birihwe.
Nihagira uwiba inka canke indogoba canke intama hanyuma akayifatanwa, uwo musuma azobirihe incuro zibiri.
Umuntu niyaragira ibitungwa vyiwe mu mirima yiwe canke mu ruzabibu rwiwe, hanyuma akonesha umurima w’abandi, azorihe ku mwimbu wiwe mwiza wa mbere w’imirima yiwe canke inzabibu ziwe.
Nihagira uwuturira ishamba hanyuma umuriro ukarandagata, ugashikira umurima w’uwundi, ugaturira ingano zitekeye canke izihagaze canke umurima wose; uwawudometse azorihe ivyo uzoba waturiye vyose.
Umuntu niyabitsa umubanyi wiwe ifeza canke inzahabu kugira ngo abishingure neza hanyuma bikibirwa mu nzu y’uwo mubanyi, uwavyivye niyafatwa azobirihe incuro zibiri.
Ariko uwavyivye natafatwa, nyene iyo nzu azorenguke imbere y’Imana kugira ngo basuzume ko atari we yavyivye.

Nihagira abantu bagira amatati bagapfa inka, indogoba, intama, impuzu canke ikindi kintu cose catakaye umwe wese yiyitirira, bompi bazoze imbere y’Imana. Uwuzotsindwa azobirihe mugenziwe incuro zibiri.
Umuntu niyabikisha mugenziwe indogoba, inka, intama canke ikindi gitungwa ico ari co cose, hanyuma kigapfa canke kigakomereka, canke kikibwa ata wundi yabibonye,
uwo yari abitunze azorahirire imbere y’ Uhoraho . Uhoraho niyemeza ko uwo mubanyi ata co yivye, nyene co azovyemere, kandi ntaze yake indishi.
Ariko nibasanga yaraciyibishije, azohe indishi nyene co.
Nimba catabaguwe n’igikoko, azozane ibisigarira kugira ngo bibe ivyemeza: ntazoheza ngo abazwe ico gitungwa.
Umuntu niyatira igitungwa kwa mugenziwe hanyuma kigakomereka canke kigapfa nyene co atari ho ari, uwagitiye azokirihe.
Ariko hagize ico kiba nyene co ari ngaho, uwagitiye ntazokirihe. Nimba igitungwa cari cakoteshejwe, amahera cakoteshejwe azobe ari yo ndishi.
Nihagira uwuryosharyosha inkumi itarakobwa akayisambanya, azorihe inkwano nk’uko umugenzo ubitegekanya, ace aba umugore wiwe.
Ariko se w’umukobwa niyanka kumumuha, na ho nyene azotange inkwano itangirwa inkumi.
Ntimuzoreke abarozi ngo babeho.
Nihagira uwusambana n’igikoko azokwicwe.
Nihagira uwutangira ikimazi iyindi mana atari jewe Uhoraho azorandurwe.
Ntimugakorere ikibi umunyamahanga canke ngo mumurenganye, kuko namwe mwigeze kuba abanyamahanga muri Egiputa.
Ntimukarenganye abapfakazi n’impfuvyi.
Nimwabarenganya bakandirira, nzokwumva amarira yabo.
Uburake bwanje buzoziriringa ndabaranduze inkota, abagore banyu babe abapfakazi, abana banyu na bo babe impfuvyi.
Nimwagurana amahera umwe mu bantu banje ari muri mwebwe akenye, ntimuzobikore nk’abadandaza, ntihagire inyungu muzomusaba.
Niwaka mugenzawe umutamana nk’ingwati, izuba ntirizorenge utarawumusubiza,
kuko uwo mutamana ushobora kuba ari wo wonyene afise wo kwipfuka. Nutawumusubiza azoheza yipfuke iki mw’ijoro? Niyandirira nzokwumva amarira yiwe, kuko ndi umunyembabazi.
Ntimugatuke Imana, canke ngo muvume abaganza ubwoko bwanyu.
Ntimuze mwigungireko ngo mureke kunshikanira amashikanwa yo ku mwimbu wanyu no ku binyobwa vyanyu. Muzonshikanire abana banyu b’abahungu b’imfura.
Muzobikore mutyo no ku bitungwa vyanyu. Umwagazi canke inyana izomarane na nyina wayo imisi indwi, ku musi ugira umunani muzozinshikanire.
Muri abantu banje bejejwe; none rero ntimuzorye inyama z’igitungwa cishwe n’igikoko. Muzogiterere imbwa.
Ntugakwiragize ibinyoma. Ntukifatanye n’abanyakibi mu kubabera icabona c’ibinyoma.
Ntugashire aho abenshi bashize mu kibi. Niwahamagarwa kuba icabona mu rubanza, ntuzohubishe ubutungane mu gushira aho benshi bashize,
kandi ntimuze mugoreke urubanza kugira ngo mufashe umukene gutsinda.
Niwahura n’inka canke indogoba y’umwansi wawe iriko irayerera, uzoyigarure uyicure kwa nyeneyo.
Niwasanga indogoba y’uwukwanka yatembagaranye n’ivyo yikoreye, ntuzoyirengane. Ahubwo uzoyivyure ubiyikureko.
Mu mburano ntimuze murenganye umukene.
Ntihazogire uwo mubeshera. Ntimuzocire urwo gupfa uwutaco azira canke imvugakuri, kuko ata na rimwe nemera ko uwutagira icaha atsindwa.
